pages.title: 数据

items.name: Kimi
items.descriptionZh: 月之暗面的对话与智能体助手，主打长上下文，网页版可直接使用。
items.descriptionEn: Moonshot AI's chat and agent assistant, built around long context and usable in the browser.

items.name: Qwen Chat
items.descriptionZh: 阿里通义千问面向国际用户的对话入口，网页版可免费使用。
items.descriptionEn: The international chat front end for Alibaba's Qwen models, free to use in the browser.

items.name: Z.ai
items.descriptionZh: 智谱面向海外用户的对话与智能体入口，提供免费使用与付费额度。
items.descriptionEn: Zhipu's chatbot and agent front end for global users, with free access and paid quotas.

items.name: Grok
items.descriptionZh: xAI 的对话助手，免费档带有速率限制，付费方案可解除。
items.descriptionEn: xAI's chat assistant; the free tier is rate limited and paid plans lift the caps.

items.name: 腾讯元宝
items.descriptionZh: 腾讯的 AI 对话与文档助手，网页版可直接使用，可用模型与额度以站内说明为准。
items.descriptionEn: Tencent's AI chat and document assistant, usable in the browser; available models and quotas are shown in the product.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多 AI 搜索与研究工具
moreCollections.titleEn: More AI search and research tools

items.name: Consensus
items.descriptionZh: 针对学术论文的问答式检索，可免费体验，完整功能需要订阅。
items.descriptionEn: A scholarly Q&A search engine; free to try, with deeper features behind a plan.

items.name: You.com
items.descriptionZh: 已从消费级搜索转向面向企业和开发者的搜索与推理 API，仍提供免费 API 密钥。
items.descriptionEn: Now positioned as enterprise search and inference APIs rather than a consumer search engine; it still advertises a free API key.

items.name: Exa
items.descriptionZh: 为 AI 智能体设计的网页与公司检索 API，官网提供免费试用额度。
items.descriptionEn: A web and company search API built for agents, with free API access advertised on the site.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多 AI 作图平台

items.name: Midjourney
items.descriptionZh: 以图像质量著称的订阅制生成服务，官方文档说明当前不提供免费试用。
items.descriptionEn: A subscription image generator known for quality; official docs state no free trial is currently available.

items.name: Microsoft Designer
items.descriptionZh: 微软的 AI 平面设计工具，官方列出免费方案，但页面提示部分市场暂不可用。
items.descriptionEn: Microsoft's AI design tool; a free plan is listed, though the page reports it is unavailable in some markets.

items.name: Ideogram
items.descriptionZh: 擅长在画面中生成清晰文字的模型；官方定价页列出每月 20 美元的 Plus 档与积分、API。
items.descriptionEn: A model known for legible in-image text; the pricing page shows a $20-a-month Plus plan plus credit and API options.

items.name: Canva
items.descriptionZh: 设计平台内的 AI 生成器，页面标注可免费使用，部分素材与功能需要订阅。
items.descriptionEn: An AI generator inside the Canva design platform; the page offers it for free, while some assets and features require a plan.

items.name: Stability AI
items.descriptionZh: 开源与商用模型并行的图像、视频与音频厂商，网页生成服务按订阅和积分计费。
items.descriptionEn: The maker of open and commercial image, video, and audio models; its web generation service is billed by subscription and credits.

items.name: Black Forest Labs
items.descriptionZh: FLUX 系列图像模型的实验室，主要通过 API 与合作伙伴提供，按用量付费。
items.descriptionEn: The lab behind the FLUX image models, delivered mainly through its API and partners on usage-based pricing.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多 AI 视频平台

items.name: Runway
items.descriptionZh: 老牌 AI 视频与编辑平台，免费档只有 125 一次性积分，付费方案按月发放额度。
items.descriptionEn: A long-standing AI video and editing platform; the free plan is a one-time 125-credit grant, while paid plans add monthly credits.

items.name: Sora
items.descriptionZh: OpenAI 的视频生成产品，网页与客户端都接入其订阅体系。
items.descriptionEn: OpenAI's video generation product, delivered through its subscription plans on web and app.

items.name: Pika
items.descriptionZh: 以短视频特效和风格化见长的消费级视频生成服务。
items.descriptionEn: A consumer video generator known for short-form effects and styling.

items.name: Luma
items.descriptionZh: 由 Dream Machine 视频模型转向创意智能体产品，官网称可免费注册开始使用。
items.descriptionEn: Formerly Dream Machine video models, now marketed as creative agents; the site advertises starting free.

items.name: 海螺视频
items.descriptionZh: MiniMax 的视频与图片生成入口，网页版提供免费体验，另有积分充值与会员。
items.descriptionEn: MiniMax's video and image generation front end, free to try in the browser with credit top-ups and memberships.

items.name: PixVerse
items.descriptionZh: 以模板与特效玩法著称的视频生成服务，官网列出订阅与积分包定价。
items.descriptionEn: A video generator known for template effects; the official site publishes subscription and credit-pack pricing.

items.name: Google Flow
items.descriptionZh: Google 的 AI 影像创作台，由 Labs 的 Flow 独立成站，需要 Google 账号登录使用。
items.descriptionEn: Google's AI filmmaking studio, spun out of Labs as its own site and requiring a Google account.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多 AI 语音工具

items.name: MiniMax Audio
items.descriptionZh: MiniMax 的文本转语音与音乐工作台，网页版可直接试用，额度以站内提示为准。
items.descriptionEn: MiniMax's text-to-speech and music studio, usable in the browser; current quotas are shown in the product.

items.name: Clipchamp
items.descriptionZh: 微软在线视频编辑器，免费版包含文本转语音、字幕与录制功能。
items.descriptionEn: Microsoft's online video editor; the free version includes text-to-speech, captions, and recording.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多转写与会议纪要工具

items.name: TurboScribe
items.descriptionZh: 订阅制的音视频转写与字幕服务，主打多语言与批量文件处理。
items.descriptionEn: A subscription transcription and subtitle service focused on multilingual and batch file work.

items.name: 飞书妙记
items.descriptionZh: 飞书内置的会议转写与纪要，随飞书账号使用，可用时长取决于所在版本。
items.descriptionEn: Feishu's built-in meeting transcription and notes; available minutes depend on your plan tier.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多 AI 音乐生成平台

items.name: Udio
items.descriptionZh: 以人声与编曲细节见长的 AI 音乐平台，当前免费额度以登录后站内提示为准。
items.descriptionEn: An AI music platform praised for vocals and arrangement; the current free allowance is shown after sign-in.

items.name: Stable Audio
items.descriptionZh: Stability 的音乐与音效生成产品，偏器乐与素材制作，免费档有额度限制。
items.descriptionEn: Stability's music and sound-effect generator, aimed at instrumentals and samples, with a capped free plan.

items.name: Google Flow Music
items.descriptionZh: 原 Riffusion 站点现跳转到 Google Flow Music，官网写有每日积分与免费开始。
items.descriptionEn: The old Riffusion domain now redirects to Google Flow Music, which advertises daily credits and a free start.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多 AI 编程工具

items.name: Amazon Q Developer
items.descriptionZh: AWS 的编程智能体，免费档每月 50 次代理请求，付费档为每人每月 19 美元。
items.descriptionEn: AWS's coding agent, with 50 agentic requests a month on the free tier and a $19-per-user paid tier.

items.name: Windsurf
items.descriptionZh: 原 Windsurf 定价页现跳转到 Devin，免费档提供少量智能体额度与无限 Tab 补全。
items.descriptionEn: The old Windsurf pricing page now redirects to Devin; its free plan gives a light agent quota and unlimited tab completions.

items.name: Aider
items.descriptionZh: 跑在终端里的开源结对编程工具，软件免费，需自备模型 API 密钥。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source terminal pair programmer; the software is free but you supply your own model API key.

items.name: Cline
items.descriptionZh: VS Code 的开源智能体插件，本身免费，模型调用按自己的密钥计费。
items.descriptionEn: A free open-source agent extension for VS Code; model calls are billed to the API key you provide.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多模型 API 平台

items.name: 阿里云百炼
items.descriptionZh: 阿里云的大模型服务平台，百余款模型按量计费，新用户有一次性免费试用额度。
items.descriptionEn: Alibaba Cloud's model platform bills over a hundred models by usage; new accounts get a one-off free trial quota.

items.name: Mistral API
items.descriptionZh: Mistral 的定价页同时列出按量计费的大模型 API 与免费的对话产品。
items.descriptionEn: Mistral's pricing page lists usage-based model APIs alongside a free chat product.

items.name: DeepSeek API
items.descriptionZh: DeepSeek 官方接口文档与计费说明，按 token 计费、需要充值。
items.descriptionEn: DeepSeek's official API docs and billing: token-priced and prepaid.

items.name: 火山方舟
items.descriptionZh: 火山引擎的大模型服务，按调用量与吞吐计费，具体模型清单以站内页面为准。
items.descriptionEn: Volcengine's model service, billed by calls and throughput; the model list is maintained on its own pages.

items.name: Z.ai API Platform
items.descriptionZh: GLM 系列模型的官方 API 平台，官网以新模型和开发者体验入口推广。
items.descriptionEn: The official API platform for GLM models, marketed around new models and developer onboarding.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多 AI 写作与办公工具
moreCollections.titleEn: More AI writing and office tools

items.name: Gamma
items.descriptionZh: 用 AI 生成演示、文档与网页；免费档赠送 400 起始积分且不再补充，需靠邀请好友获取。
items.descriptionEn: AI presentations, documents, and pages; the free plan grants 400 starter credits that do not refill, topped up only by inviting friends.

items.name: Origin
items.descriptionZh: Cursor 的代码托管平台，支持 GitHub 仓库同步与 AI 协作，需要付费方案。
items.descriptionEn: Cursor’s code hosting platform with GitHub mirroring and AI workflows; a paid plan is required.

items.name: Assembla
items.descriptionZh: 提供 Git、SVN 与 Git LFS 的商业托管，适合多版本控制工具协作，仅提供限时试用。
items.descriptionEn: Commercial Git, SVN, and Git LFS hosting for teams using multiple version-control tools; only a time-limited trial is free.

items.name: Gitea
items.descriptionZh: 免费开源的 Git 自建软件，需自己准备服务器和维护，并非免费云托管。
items.descriptionEn: Free, open-source Git software you host and maintain yourself; it does not include free cloud hosting.

items.name: Savannah
items.descriptionZh: 面向自由软件项目的免费托管，须符合许可与依赖要求，并通过项目审核。
items.descriptionEn: Free hosting for free-software projects, subject to license and dependency requirements and project approval.

items.name: GitGud
items.descriptionZh: 社区运营的免费 GitLab 托管，支持公开与私有仓库，部分地区访问受限。
items.descriptionEn: Community-run, free GitLab hosting for public and private repositories, with access restrictions in some regions.

items.name: Framagit
items.descriptionZh: Framasoft 运营的免费 GitLab 平台，适合社区项目，需留意注册条件与实例配额。
items.descriptionEn: A free GitLab platform run by Framasoft for community projects; check its registration rules and instance quotas.

items.name: Railway
items.descriptionZh: 全栈应用与数据库的部署平台，订阅 Hobby 档 $5/月起，资源另按秒计费（内存 $0.00000386/GB·秒、vCPU $0.00000772/vCPU·秒），长期常驻的服务累计会超过同规格的固定月费方案。
items.descriptionEn: A full-stack and database deploy platform: the Hobby subscription is $5 a month and resources then bill per second ($0.00000386 per GB-second of memory, $0.00000772 per vCPU-second), so an always-on service accumulates more than a flat-rate equivalent.

items.name: Fly.io
items.descriptionZh: 把应用跑在靠近用户的边缘虚拟机上，官方称无平台月费、纯按用量计费，最小常驻机型约 $2.19/30 天、出站流量 $0.02/GB；新组织已无免费层，只剩最长 2 小时机时或 7 天的试用，且用量没有硬上限，得自己设告警。
items.descriptionEn: Edge VMs near your users with no monthly platform fee - everything is usage-based, from about $2.19 per 30 days for the smallest always-on machine plus $0.02/GB egress. New organizations get no free tier, only a trial capped at 2 hours of runtime or 7 days, and nothing caps usage, so set your own alerts.

items.name: Heroku
items.descriptionZh: 老牌应用托管平台，2022 年 11 月 28 日起取消免费 dyno 与免费数据库；Eco 档 $5/月用的是共享池化算力，要一直在线得从 Standard $25/月起，账单可预测但同样的资源比按量方案贵一档。
items.descriptionEn: The long-standing app platform retired its free dynos and free databases on 2022-11-28. The $5/month Eco plan runs on pooled shared capacity, and staying always-on starts at Standard $25/month - predictable bills, but a tier dearer than usage-based rivals for the same resources.

items.name: Hostinger
items.descriptionZh: 面向不写代码的建站者的共享主机，促销价 $2.49/月看着最低，但要求一次预付 48 个月，续费回到 $10.99/月；含首年免费域名与 20GB 存储。
items.descriptionEn: Shared hosting for people who do not write code: $2.49 a month looks like the floor, but it requires 48 months prepaid and renews at $10.99 a month, with a free first-year domain and 20GB of storage.

items.name: DreamHost
items.descriptionZh: 同为共享主机，年付 $2.89/月、月付 $10.99，含 25 个站点与 25GB NVMe，约 4 万月访问是软上限；好处是不必超长预付就能拿到接近年付的价。
items.descriptionEn: Also shared hosting, at $2.89 a month billed yearly or $10.99 monthly, with 25 sites and 25GB of NVMe and a soft ceiling around 40k monthly visits - the point being you are not locked into a long prepayment to get near the yearly rate.

items.name: Neocities
items.descriptionZh: 免费静态网站托管，约 1 GB 空间，仅支持静态页面，自定义域名需付费。
items.descriptionEn: Free static site hosting with about 1 GB of storage; static pages only, and custom domains require a paid plan.

items.name: Qoddi
items.descriptionZh: 荷兰的容器托管平台，免费可跑 3 个静态站且官网称不限流量，应用档 $6/月起、按秒计费并写明最多收到公布的月价；厂商规模小，条款与长期存续还要自己判断。
items.descriptionEn: A Dutch container hosting platform: three static sites free with what its site calls unlimited bandwidth, and app plans from $6 a month billed per second up to the published monthly maximum. It is a small vendor, so weigh its terms and longevity yourself.

items.name: Hetzner
items.descriptionZh: 自己的机房，按小时计费但账单以月价封顶，1GB 级云主机约 6 欧元未税起，是这一组里最便宜的；IPv4 明码 0.50 欧元一个月、IPv6 免费，代价是官网价目表由脚本渲染，具体型号单价要登进控制台才看得到，且注册常要真人身份验证。
items.descriptionEn: Runs its own data centers and bills by the hour but caps the bill at the monthly price, with 1GB cloud servers from about EUR 6 net - the cheapest in this group. IPv4 is a stated EUR 0.50 a month and IPv6 is free; the catch is that its price matrix is script-rendered, so per-model prices only appear once you are logged into the console, and sign-up usually needs real identity checks.

items.name: OVHcloud
items.descriptionZh: 最低的 VPS 档 2 核 4GB 每月 4.54 美元未税，已含每日备份和一个 IPv4；流量不限量、只按端口速率给到 3Gbps，所以不会出现流量超额账单；付款方式官方只列信用卡和 PayPal，社区反映对中国人注册审核严。
items.descriptionEn: Its cheapest VPS - 2 cores, 4GB - is USD 4.54 a month net with daily backups and one IPv4 already included, and traffic is unmetered up to a 3Gbps port, so an overage bill cannot happen; the official payment list is cards and PayPal only, and users report strict sign-up review for applicants from China.

items.name: Alibaba Cloud 阿里云
items.descriptionZh: 境内买服务器的默认入口：经济型 ECS 2 核 2G/3M 固定带宽/40G 盘 99 元一年、限购 1 台，且是这一组里唯一被官方明写「新购与续费同享优惠」的；轻量 68 元一年只限首购、续费按正常定价，新一代轻量不收流量费但 200Mbps 只是出入共享的峰值上限；境内建站要先个人实名、包年包月满 3 个月才能备案。
items.descriptionEn: The default entry point in mainland China: its Economy e-instance - 2 cores, 2GB, 3Mbps fixed bandwidth, 40GB disk - is ¥99 a year, one per account, and the only plan here whose renewal price the vendor explicitly locks to the same deal. The ¥68 Lightweight year is first purchase only and renews at list price, newer Lightweight plans charge no traffic yet guarantee only a shared 200Mbps peak, and a mainland website needs personal identity checks plus three months of subscription before ICP filing.

items.name: Vultr
items.descriptionZh: 1 vCPU/1GB 每月 5 美元、含 1TB 出站流量，超出按 0.01 美元每 GB 计，可选机房三十多个，按小时计费并设月度封顶；这组数字是 2026-10-27 官网直连读到的。
items.descriptionEn: USD 5 a month for 1 vCPU/1GB with 1TB of egress included and USD 0.01 per GB beyond that, across thirty-something locations, billed hourly with the monthly price as a cap - all read directly from the official site on 2026-10-27.

items.name: Linode
items.descriptionZh: 最小的 1GB 档每月 5 美元、含 1TB 流量，超出只收 0.005 美元每 GB，是这一组里最低的超额单价，按小时计费、月价封顶；但这组数字取自 2026-02-07 的官方价目页存档（当天直连被拒），下单前请再核一次。
items.descriptionEn: Its smallest 1GB plan is USD 5 a month with 1TB of transfer, and overage costs USD 0.005 per GB - the lowest rate in this group - billed hourly with a monthly cap; but these figures come from a 2026-02-07 archive of the official pricing page, which refused us today, so re-check before ordering.

items.name: DigitalOcean
items.descriptionZh: 面向开发者的老牌云主机。云服务器机型没有免费档，新账号只有 $200 赠金、60 天用完整就开始扣卡；官方文档列明支持支付宝与银联，但拒绝虚拟卡与预付卡。
items.descriptionEn: A long-standing developer cloud whose Droplet sizes carry no free option - new accounts get a $200 credit that starts billing your card once it is spent or 60 days pass. Official docs list Alipay and UnionPay among payment methods but rule out virtual and prepaid cards.

items.name: AWS Lightsail
items.descriptionZh: AWS 把服务器、流量和 DNS 打包成固定月价的轻量云：1GB/2vCPU/2TB 每月 5 美元，含一个静态 IPv4，按小时计费、以月价封顶。坑在超额：流量用完套餐配额后从 0.09 美元每 GB 起收（部分区域 0.12 至 0.15），访问量一涨账单就失控。
items.descriptionEn: AWS bundles the server, transfer and DNS into flat monthly prices: $5 a month for 1GB/2vCPU with 2TB and a static IPv4, billed hourly and capped at the monthly price. The trap is overage - once the bundled transfer runs out it costs from $0.09 per GB ($0.12 to $0.15 in some regions), so a traffic spike takes the bill out of your control.

items.name: Tencent Cloud 腾讯云
items.descriptionZh: 全部在售套餐的刊例月价公开成一张静态表，续费也享时长折扣（满 12 个月 85 折），价格可读性比阿里好；但主推的入门型与通用型都带每月流量包、超出 0.8 元每 GB，无限流量的锐驰型一欠费就「直接进入网络隔离中」，活动页 109 元一年的 4 核 4G 不在在售表里、续费原价查不到；官方充值只列微信支付、QQ 钱包和网银，没有支付宝。
items.descriptionEn: Every on-sale plan's list price sits in one public static table and renewals get term discounts (15% off from 12 months), so its pricing is easier to read than Alibaba's. But the plans it pushes carry monthly traffic caps billed at ¥0.8 per GB, the unlimited-traffic 锐驰型 goes straight into network isolation the moment an account owes money, the ¥109 4-core/4GB promo tier is not in the on-sale table so its renewal price cannot be checked, and top-up takes WeChat Pay, QQ Wallet and banks - no Alipay.

items.name: Huawei Cloud 华为云
items.descriptionZh: 境内大厂里年价最容易读到的：Flexus L 实例 2 核 2G/2M 峰值带宽/40G 盘含 100GB 每月流量，产品页标价 ¥329.32 一年；超额 ¥0.8 每 GB、只算出网；充值支持支付宝、微信、银联和转账汇款，五天无理由全额退订每账号每自然年有 10 个实例额度；备案要包月满 3 个月、每台最多 5 个网站。
items.descriptionEn: The mainland vendor whose annual price is easiest to read without hunting a promo: a Flexus L instance with 2 cores, 2GB, a 40GB disk and 2Mbps peak bandwidth costs ¥329.32 a year on its own product page and includes 100GB of monthly traffic, overage is ¥0.8 per GB on outbound only, top-up takes Alipay, WeChat Pay, UnionPay or bank transfer, five-day no-reason refunds allow ten instances per account a year, and mainland ICP filing needs three prepaid months with five websites per server.

items.name: JD Cloud 京东云
items.descriptionZh: 套餐价目表整张公开：2 核 2G/3M 带宽含 200GB 每月流量 ¥43.56 一月，超额 ¥0.8 每 GB、只算出网、按天出账；退款条件最紧：五天无理由每主体每自然年只覆盖 1 台云主机、年退款上限 10 万元、降过配的预付费订单不退；支付清单里没有支付宝和银联，预付费订单须在 15 天内付款。
items.descriptionEn: Its whole Lightweight price sheet is public: 2 cores, 2GB, 3Mbps and a 200GB monthly package is ¥43.56 a month, overage ¥0.8 per GB on outbound traffic billed daily. The exit terms are the tightest here - five-day no-reason refunds cover one cloud server per verified subject a year, refunds cap at ¥100,000 a year and an order you downgraded cannot be refunded, no Alipay or UnionPay appears in the payment list, and prepaid orders must be paid within 15 days.

items.name: UCloud 优刻得
items.descriptionZh: 流量给得最大方：内地 2 核 2G/4M 含 1000GB 每月流量 ¥99 一月，香港与海外 1 核 1G/30M 含 200GB 只 ¥34 一月；超额内地和香港 ¥0.8 每 GB、洛杉矶 0.5、其余海外 0.7。代价在退订：官方文档里没有五天无理由那一档，删除资源按「实付减已消费」退、按月订单的已消费要乘 1.5，欠费三天关机限服、第七天回收且数据不可恢复。
items.descriptionEn: The most generous traffic allowance: mainland 2 cores, 2GB and 4Mbps come with 1000GB a month for ¥99, Hong Kong and overseas 1 core, 1GB and 30Mbps with 200GB for ¥34, and overage is ¥0.8 per GB in the mainland and Hong Kong, ¥0.5 in Los Angeles and ¥0.7 elsewhere. The catch is leaving - its documentation has no five-day no-reason tier, deleting a resource pays back what was paid minus consumption counted at 1.5x for monthly orders, and an unpaid server is shut for three days then reclaimed on day seven with data gone.

items.name: Hostinger VPS
items.descriptionZh: 用大内存压价的 VPS：KVM 1（1 vCPU/4GB/50GB 硬盘/4TB 流量）促销价每月 6.49 美元，页面明写同期续费 11.99 美元、原价 19.49 美元；配额内流量不另收费，官方付款页列支付宝与银联。
items.descriptionEn: Its VPS line is cheap because it packs memory: KVM 1 (1 vCPU, 4GB, 50GB disk, 4TB transfer) is $6.49 a month on promotion, with the page stating $11.99 to renew for the same term against a $19.49 list price; traffic inside the allowance costs nothing extra and the official payment page lists Alipay and UnionPay.

items.name: Contabo
items.descriptionZh: 用大内存摊薄单价：在售最小的 4 核 8GB/100GB SSD 档只要 4.40 欧元未税，流量宣称不限量；但每一档都标注「首 24 个月」，到期后的续费价官网没有公布，不限量也受公平使用策略约束。
items.descriptionEn: It dilutes the price with memory: the smallest plan it sells - 4 cores, 8GB, 100GB SSD - is EUR 4.40 net and traffic is called unlimited; but every tier is labelled "for the first 24 months", the renewal price after that is not published, and the unlimited claim is bound by a fair-use policy.

items.name: Cloudflare Registrar
items.descriptionZh: 官方明写不加价，并把算出来的逐后缀价目表直接挂出来：.com 注册、续费、转入同为 10.46 美元，调价页已预告 2026-11-01 起涨到 11.17，赎回 40 美元；WHOIS 信息遮蔽免费。代价是这类域名必须用 Cloudflare 的 Nameserver，想换 DNS 服务商只能整域转出。
items.descriptionEn: It sells at cost and publishes the resulting per-extension table: .com registration, renewal and transfer are all $10.46, with its price-changes page already announcing $11.17 from 2026-11-01 and $40 to restore; WHOIS redaction is free. The catch is that these domains must keep Cloudflare nameservers, so moving DNS elsewhere means transferring the domain out.

items.name: Dynadot
items.descriptionZh: .com 的注册、续费与转入同价，2026-10-27 官网为 10.88 美元；另有官方中文页写明支持支付宝人民币，没有外币卡也能买，账号可开硬件密钥。
items.descriptionEn: One price for .com registration, renewal and transfer - $10.88 as of 2026-10-27 - and an official Chinese page confirms Alipay in RMB, so it works without a foreign card; hardware-key 2FA is supported.

items.name: Porkbun
items.descriptionZh: .com 注册、续费与转入同为 11.08 美元（2026-10-27 官网），WHOIS 隐私默认免费，官方付款页把支付宝列在支持方式里；注册时需要填真实地址才过审。
items.descriptionEn: $11.08 for .com registration, renewal and transfer (checked 2026-10-27), with WHOIS privacy free by default and Alipay listed on its official payment page; sign-up does require a real postal address.

items.name: iz.rs
items.descriptionZh: 塞尔维亚 Iz.rs 在真 ccTLD 的 .rs 下发放免费 *.iz.rs，官网明写注册不过期、无需续费，也不许第三方代收费用；要先自行配好 DNS、24 小时内建出站点，并在 30 天内提交审批材料。
items.descriptionEn: Free *.iz.rs names under the real .rs ccTLD from Serbia's Iz.rs, which states registrations never expire or need renewal and no third party may charge for them; point your DNS first, have a live site within 24 hours, and file approval papers within 30 days.

items.name: DigitalPlat Domains
items.descriptionZh: 用 GitHub 账号在控制台免费领取 .dpdns.org、.us.kg、.qzz.io 等后缀，可自设 Nameserver 交给 Cloudflare；额度与回收规则需在控制台确认。
items.descriptionEn: Claim .dpdns.org, .us.kg, .qzz.io and other suffixes free from its console with a GitHub account, with custom nameservers so Cloudflare can serve them; check the console for quotas and reclaim rules.

items.name: Co.Nf
items.descriptionZh: Biz.nf 旗下免费 *.co.nf 二级域名，每账号最多 50 个且无需续费，但与免费主机业务绑定，共享父域常被滥用；同页还在卖主机与 SSL，co.nf 本身没有付费续费方案。
items.descriptionEn: Free *.co.nf second-level domains from the Biz.nf team, up to 50 per account with no renewal fee, bundled with free hosting on a heavily abused parent domain; the same page sells hosting and SSL, though co.nf itself has no paid renewal plan.

items.name: DNSHE
items.descriptionZh: 自述新加坡团队的免费注册，发 .de5.net、.us.ci、.cc.cd 等已进公共后缀列表的后缀，不要信用卡；默认一年有效、到期前 180 天可免费续期，可改 Nameserver，靠好友助力能转成永久免续。
items.descriptionEn: Free names on public-suffix-listed endings such as .de5.net, .us.ci and .cc.cd from a self-described Singapore team, with no credit card; terms run a year and renew free in the last 180 days, nameservers are editable, and friend referrals can convert a name to permanent no-renewal.

items.name: Kev Service
items.descriptionZh: 个人运营的多后缀免费注册，含已进公共后缀列表的 .ae.kg 以及 .kedns.de、.ksapp.me；负责 Nameserver 委派、写明续费也免费，部分名字要说明用途过审核，偶尔改成邀请码制。
items.descriptionEn: A one-person registry offering several free endings, including public-suffix-listed .ae.kg plus .kedns.de and .ksapp.me; it delegates nameservers and says renewals stay free, some names need a stated purpose to pass review, and invite codes are enabled from time to time.

items.name: Intent (int.yt)
items.descriptionZh: 非营利项目 Intent 发免费 *.int.yt，4 个字符以上即时通过、1 到 3 字符要人工审核防抢注，由 Hack Club 提供 501(c)(3) 财政赞助；Nameserver 只能指向 FreeDNS 或 Namecheap。
items.descriptionEn: The non-profit Intent gives out free *.int.yt names with Hack Club's 501(c)(3) fiscal sponsorship; four characters or more clear instantly, one to three need manual review against squatting, and nameservers only work with FreeDNS or Namecheap.

items.name: Public Free Suffix
items.descriptionZh: 2025 年起由社区运营，在 .is-a.si、.bg5.net、.pfsdns.org 等根域下发免费子域，官网写明永不收年费；父域归项目所有，不活跃 30 天即回收。
items.descriptionEn: A community project since 2025 handing out free names under roots such as .is-a.si, .bg5.net and .pfsdns.org, stating there are never annual fees; the project owns the parent domains and reclaims names idle for 30 days.

items.name: runs-on.dev
items.descriptionZh: Advance Labs 自费持有父域，任何人都能免费领 *.runs-on.dev，官方 FAQ 明说没有付费层；同时也直说自己不是顶级域名、规则随时可变。
items.descriptionEn: Advance Labs pays for the parent domain and gives *.runs-on.dev away with no paid tier, per its own FAQ, which is equally blunt that this is not a top-level domain and the terms can change.

items.name: Devs.Surf
items.descriptionZh: 2026 年初出现的免费子域名服务，邮箱注册后可即时认领并自带 A、CNAME、TXT 解析，但不活跃可能被回收。
items.descriptionEn: Free subdomains since early 2026, claimed instantly after email sign-up with built-in A, CNAME, and TXT records, though inactive names can be reclaimed.

items.name: Lovie.me
items.descriptionZh: 2026 年 10 月上线的免费子域名平台，每人可长期持有 3 个 *.lovie.me 并自带 DNS 托管，但由个人运营、连续 24 个月不登录会被回收。
items.descriptionEn: Free *.lovie.me subdomains from a platform launched in October 2026; three per account with hosted DNS, but it is run by a single operator and reclaimed after 24 months without login.

items.name: localhost.cc
items.descriptionZh: 中文团队的自助免费二级域名，另持有 888.moe 根域，官网称完全免费、免费续费并自带解析记录管理；项目很新，未公布额度与不活跃回收规则。
items.descriptionEn: Self-service free second-level domains from a Chinese team that also runs the 888.moe root, described on the site as entirely free with free renewals and built-in record management; the project is new and publishes no quota or idle-reclaim rules.

items.name: NodeLoc 免费域名
items.descriptionZh: 中文社区 NodeLoc 用 Yunamo 平台向成员发放 loc.cc 等根域下的免费子域名；账号等级决定额度和可用根域，超过 90 天不活跃可在不通知的情况下删除。
items.descriptionEn: Free subdomains under roots such as loc.cc for members of the Chinese NodeLoc community, served by the Yunamo platform; your account level sets the quota and usable roots, and names idle past 90 days can be deleted without notice.

items.name: nn.kg
items.descriptionZh: 自称私营域名注册处，开放免费 .nn.kg 注册、注册前不审核，可指向自己的 Nameserver，还自建了 WHOIS 与 RDAP；条款里没有续费或到期约定，.nn.kg 也不在公共后缀列表。
items.descriptionEn: A self-described private registry taking free .nn.kg sign-ups without pre-approval, letting you use your own nameservers and running its own WHOIS and RDAP; its terms say nothing about renewals or expiry, and .nn.kg is not on the public suffix list.

items.name: sld.tw
items.descriptionZh: 台湾志愿者运营的免费二级域名，解析托管在腾讯 DNSPod；注册后 7 天内必须建站或做重定向，否则约一个月后可能被删，初始一年有效期在正常使用下自动延期。
items.descriptionEn: Free second-level domains run by volunteers in Taiwan with DNSPod-hosted resolution; you must launch a site or set a redirect within 7 days or the name may be dropped after about a month, and the initial one-year term extends on its own while in use.

items.name: Stackryze Domains
items.descriptionZh: 验证 GitHub 后可领 .sryze.cc、.nx.kg 等后缀，每账号 5 个、有效期一年需手动续期，可自设 Nameserver。
items.descriptionEn: Suffixes such as .sryze.cc and .nx.kg unlock after GitHub verification, five domains per account on one-year terms you renew by hand, with custom nameservers.

items.name: DnsNeko
items.descriptionZh: 提供 .zh.kg、.os.kg、.tw.kg 免费子域名与解析，但官网未披露运营主体，2026 年 6 月曾整体暂停注册。
items.descriptionEn: Free .zh.kg, .os.kg, and .tw.kg subdomains with resolution, but the site discloses no operator and suspended all registrations in June 2026.

items.name: thedev.id
items.descriptionZh: 面向开发者个人站的免费子域名，改 GitHub 注册表提交 PR、经人工审核后发放。
items.descriptionEn: Free subdomains for developer personal sites, issued after a manually reviewed pull request against the GitHub registry.

items.name: js.cool
items.descriptionZh: 面向中文开源项目与 GitHub Pages、Vercel 部署的免费 *.js.cool 子域名，经 GitHub 申请。
items.descriptionEn: Free *.js.cool subdomains aimed at Chinese open-source projects and GitHub Pages or Vercel deployments, requested through GitHub.

items.name: js.org
items.descriptionZh: 为 JavaScript 相关开源项目提供免费的 *.js.org 子域名，经 GitHub 申请。
items.descriptionEn: Free *.js.org subdomains for JavaScript-related open-source projects, requested through GitHub.

items.name: No-IP
items.descriptionZh: 提供免费动态 DNS 主机名，但需每隔约 30 天手动确认才会保留。
items.descriptionEn: Free dynamic DNS hostnames, but they must be manually confirmed about every 30 days to stay active.

items.name: Dynu
items.descriptionZh: 免费动态 DNS 与域名托管，功能齐全但界面偏技术向。
items.descriptionEn: Free dynamic DNS and domain hosting; full-featured but more technical in feel.

items.name: PlanetScale
items.descriptionZh: 托管 MySQL 与 Postgres，含水平分片和 PlanetScale Metal 本地盘机型；定价页最低的 Postgres 单节点档写明 $5/月起，页面上已无免费方案。
items.descriptionEn: Managed MySQL and Postgres with horizontal sharding and local-NVMe Metal machines; the cheapest Postgres single-node tier on its pricing page starts at $5 a month and no free plan is listed.

items.name: CockroachDB
items.descriptionZh: 分布式 SQL 数据库，官网给新组织的是 30 天试用加 $400 额度而不是长期免费层，标准档 $0.092/vCPU-小时起（约 2 vCPU·100 GB 每月 $203）。
items.descriptionEn: A distributed SQL database whose site offers new organizations a 30-day trial with $400 in credit rather than a lasting free tier, with Standard compute from $0.092 per vCPU-hour (about $203 a month for 2 vCPU and 100GB).

items.name: Amazon RDS
items.descriptionZh: AWS 托管关系数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、MariaDB、Oracle、SQL Server 等），按实例小时与存储计费；新账号的免费方式已是 $200 赠金加 6 个月，用满或到期就要付费。
items.descriptionEn: AWS's managed relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server), billed by instance-hours and storage; new accounts now get $200 in credits over 6 months instead of long-running free instances.

items.name: Firebase Firestore
items.descriptionZh: Google 的文档型 NoSQL 数据库，官方写明每个项目只能有一个免费数据库：1 GiB 存储、每天 5 万次读、2 万次写与 2 万次删、每月 10 GiB 出网；要超出就得给项目开通结算。
items.descriptionEn: Google's document NoSQL database, which allows exactly one free database per project: 1 GiB stored, 50,000 reads, 20,000 writes and 20,000 deletes a day, and 10 GiB of monthly egress - going past that means enabling billing on the project.

items.name: Aiven Free Tier
items.descriptionZh: Aiven 的常免费托管 PostgreSQL：1 GB 存储、1 GB 内存、每 VM 1 CPU、单节点无高可用，注册不需信用卡、没有时限，但官方说明长期不用的实例会被停机。
items.descriptionEn: Aiven's always-free managed PostgreSQL: 1GB of storage, 1GB RAM and 1 CPU on a single node with no high availability, no card and no time limit, though the docs say unused instances are powered off.

items.name: TiDB Cloud Starter
items.descriptionZh: Serverless 的分布式 SQL（MySQL 兼容），每个组织默认可建 5 个免费 Starter 实例，各给 5 GiB 行存、5 GiB 列存与每月 5,000 万 RU；超量不自动扣费，而是限制新连接并对已有连接限流。
items.descriptionEn: Serverless distributed SQL compatible with MySQL: five free Starter instances per organization by default, each with 5 GiB row storage, 5 GiB columnar storage and 50 million request units a month, and past the quota it throttles instead of billing.

items.name: Qdrant Cloud
items.descriptionZh: 向量数据库云服务，免费集群固定为单节点 0.5 vCPU、1 GB 内存、4 GB 磁盘，定价页标 Free forever 并写明面向测试与原型。
items.descriptionEn: Managed vector database: the free cluster is a fixed single node with 0.5 vCPU, 1GB RAM and 4GB disk, labelled free forever and aimed at testing and prototypes.

items.name: Amazon S3
items.descriptionZh: 对象存储的事实标准，生态与接口兼容性最广；2025 年起新账号不再自动获得 5 GB 免费存储，而是 $200 赠金加 6 个月，请求与出网按量另计。
items.descriptionEn: The de facto standard for object storage with the widest ecosystem and API compatibility; new accounts no longer get 5GB of free storage but $200 in credits over 6 months, with requests and egress metered separately.

items.name: Wasabi
items.descriptionZh: 以固定单价 $7.99/TB/月、出网与 API 全不收费为卖点，但没有长期免费额度：试用对公司邮箱是 100 GB/30 天、免费邮箱 10 GB/14 天，且设有 90 天最短存储期和按 1 TB 计的最低月费。
items.descriptionEn: Flat $7.99 per TB-month with no egress or API fees, but no lasting free tier: the trial is 100GB for 30 days on a company email or 10GB for 14 days on a freemail address, with a 90-day minimum retention and a minimum monthly charge tied to 1TB.

items.name: Hetzner Object Storage
items.descriptionZh: Hetzner 的 S3 兼容对象存储，机位在欧洲，随存储量线性计价；产品与计费页未列任何免费额度，属纯付费服务。
items.descriptionEn: Hetzner's S3-compatible object storage in European locations, priced linearly with capacity; its product and billing pages list no free allowance at all, so treat it as paid-only.

items.name: 七牛云对象存储 Kodo
items.descriptionZh: 境内常用的对象存储，实名认证用户可享标准存储 0-10 GB、GET 请求 100 万次、Put/Delete 10 万次与 CDN 回源流出流量 10 GB 的免费额度；官方测试域名会被回收，对外访问要自有域名，中国大陆域名还得备案。
items.descriptionEn: A mainstream object store in mainland China: verified accounts get 0-10GB of standard storage, 1 million GETs, 100,000 PUT/DELETE calls and 10GB of CDN back-to-origin traffic free. Its test domain is reclaimed, so public access needs your own domain, which must be ICP-filed for mainland sites.

items.name: 京东云对象存储 OSS
items.descriptionZh: 首次开通 OSS 的个人与企业用户按地域领取免费资源包：标准存储 10 GB、请求 50 万次，账户正常就按月发放，但当月有效、不结转，也只抵扣标准存储类型。
items.descriptionEn: New OSS accounts claim a monthly resource package per region - 10GB of standard storage and 500,000 requests - issued while the account is in good standing, valid only within the month with no rollover, and applicable to the standard storage class alone.

items.name: Google Cloud Storage
items.descriptionZh: GCS 的常免费额度是标准存储每月 5 GB-月、Class A 操作 5,000 次、Class B 50,000 次，且只算 us-west1、us-central1、us-east1 三个区域合并用量；试用期结束后仍然有效，但要先绑定结算账号。
items.descriptionEn: Cloud Storage's always-free limits are 5 GB-months of standard storage, 5,000 Class A and 50,000 Class B operations a month, counted only across us-west1, us-central1 and us-east1 combined; they survive the trial period but still need a billing account attached.

items.name: Neon Object Storage
items.descriptionZh: Neon 免费方案的每个项目附带 5 GB 的 S3 兼容对象存储，与同一个账号里的 Postgres 一起用、超出按 $0.023/GB-月计；得先接受 Neon 的项目与计算额度结构。
items.descriptionEn: Every Neon free-plan project includes 5GB of S3-compatible object storage alongside its Postgres, with overage at $0.023 per GB-month - useful only if Neon's project and compute allowances suit you.

items.name: Filebase
items.descriptionZh: 把 S3 兼容对象存储与 IPFS 固定放在一起的平台，免费方案 5 GB 存储（两类共用）、500 个固定文件、10 GB IPFS 出网且对象出网不收费；自定义域名要到 $7.5/月的 Pro 档。
items.descriptionEn: A platform pairing S3-compatible storage with IPFS pinning: the free plan has 5GB pooled across both, 500 pinned files, 10GB of IPFS egress and free object egress, while custom domains need the $7.50/month Pro tier.

items.name: MinIO AIStor Free
items.descriptionZh: 自托管对象存储，AIStor Free 单机部署免费且功能完整，只有社区文档与支持、并禁止再分发；原先 AGPLv3 的开源版官方已声明停止维护、代码冻结，不再发安全补丁。
items.descriptionEn: Self-hosted object storage: AIStor Free is full-featured at no cost for a single-node deployment, backed only by community docs and with redistribution prohibited, while MinIO states its former AGPLv3 open-source edition is frozen and no longer receives security patches.

items.name: Logto
items.descriptionZh: 开源的身份与 SSO 方案，云端免费方案给 5 万 MAU、5 万 token 与 3 个应用且不需信用卡；RBAC、组织多租户、MFA 与企业 SSO 都在 Pro（$24/月起）或单独计费的附加包里。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source identity and SSO option whose free cloud plan gives 50,000 MAU, 50K tokens and 3 applications with no card, while RBAC, organizations, MFA and enterprise SSO sit in Pro (from $24 a month) or separately priced add-ons.

items.name: Descope
items.descriptionZh: 免费 Forever 方案含 7,500 MAU、10 个租户、3 个 SSO 连接与 1 万个 M2M 交换，官网写明不产生超额费用、但超限必须升级才能继续；自定义域名从 $249/月的 Pro 起。
items.descriptionEn: The Free Forever plan covers 7,500 MAU, 10 tenants, 3 SSO connections and 10,000 M2M exchanges, with the site stating there are no overages but you must upgrade to keep going past them; custom domains start at the $249/month Pro tier.

items.name: WorkOS AuthKit
items.descriptionZh: 面向 B2B SaaS 的用户管理与企业 SSO 基础设施，前 100 万活跃用户免费、每多 100 万 $2,500/月，单个 SAML/OIDC 连接 $125/月；是给要做企业客户的团队用的，不是个人项目的默认选择。
items.descriptionEn: User management and enterprise SSO infrastructure for B2B SaaS: the first 1 million active users are free, each further million costs $2,500 a month and each SAML/OIDC connection $125 - built for teams selling to enterprises, not the default choice for a hobby project.

items.name: Appwrite
items.descriptionZh: 开源自托管为主的后台即服务平台，云端免费方案可用，但官方 FAQ 写明触达资源上限后项目会被冻结、控制台转为只读，要升级、删掉超限资源或等下个账期重置。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source backend-as-a-service, mostly self-hosted, with a free cloud plan; its FAQ states that hitting a resource limit freezes the project and leaves the console read-only until you upgrade, free up resources, or wait for the next billing cycle.

items.name: Frontegg
items.descriptionZh: 专做 B2B SaaS 用户与组织管理的身份平台，按需付费方案免费到 7,500 MAU、5 个企业连接（SSO/SCIM）、无限组织并含自定义域名；更大规模与合规要求要走企业销售报价。
items.descriptionEn: An identity platform built for B2B SaaS user and organization management: its pay-as-you-go tier is free up to 7,500 MAU, 5 enterprise SSO/SCIM connections, unlimited organizations and a custom domain, with larger scale handled through enterprise sales.

items.name: Zitadel
items.descriptionZh: 开源的多租户身份平台，云端免费方案按日活跃用户计，只给 100 DAU、1 个实例与 5,000 次管理 API 调用，Pro 从 $100/月起；也可以自行部署开源版，但那是要自己运维的另一种成本。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source multi-tenant identity platform: Zitadel Cloud's free plan is measured in daily active users - 100 DAU, one instance and 5,000 management API calls - with Pro from $100 a month, or you can self-host the open-source edition and own the operations.

items.name: SuperTokens
items.descriptionZh: 开源的登录与会话方案，定价页写明自托管核心功能免费且没有用户数上限；官方托管云服务 5,000 MAU 以内不收费，之后 $0.02/MAU。
items.descriptionEn: Open-source auth and session infrastructure: its pricing page says self-hosting the core features is free with no MAU limit, while the managed cloud service costs nothing under 5,000 MAU and $0.02 per MAU after that.

items.name: Authgear
items.descriptionZh: 云端免费方案号称月活用户不限，但只有 2 个应用、2 个管理员席位、每月 100 条短信/WhatsApp 验证码与 1 天日志保留，支持仅社区文档；付费的 Developers 档 $50/月。
items.descriptionEn: The free cloud plan advertises unlimited monthly active users yet allows only 2 applications, 2 admin seats, 100 SMS/WhatsApp codes a month and 1 day of log retention with community support; the $50-a-month Developers tier lifts those.

items.name: Authing 身份云
items.descriptionZh: 国内的身份云平台（单点登录、自适应 MFA、统一权限），免费版给 8,000 MAU、1 个社交账号连接与 1 个自建应用；官方公告自 2025-02-26 起免费用户池每天只有 50 次邮件发送额度，且全部公有云版本都做 API 限流。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese identity cloud with SSO, adaptive MFA and unified permissions: the free tier gives 8,000 MAU, one social connection and one built-in app, while an official notice caps free pools at 50 sent emails a day since 2025-02-26 and every public-cloud version is rate-limited on API calls.

items.name: Confluence
items.descriptionZh: Atlassian 的团队知识库与文档协作，常与 Jira 配套；官方定价页同时列出免费档与按人计费的付费档。
items.descriptionEn: Atlassian's team wiki and document space, often paired with Jira; the official pricing page lists both a free plan and per-user paid plans.

items.name: XWiki
items.descriptionZh: 开源的企业知识库，官方把自己定位为 Confluence、Notion 与 SharePoint 的替代；官网的托管版本写明是最多 30 天的试用，长期用要自托管或订阅。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source enterprise wiki pitched as an alternative to Confluence, Notion and SharePoint; the hosted offering on its site is a trial of up to 30 days, so long-term use means self-hosting or a subscription.

items.name: FlowUs 息流
items.descriptionZh: 国内的块级笔记与知识库，定价页标注免费版永久免费，但区块数、存储与协作者数量有限。
items.descriptionEn: A China-based block note and wiki whose pricing page calls the free plan permanently free, with limits on blocks, storage and collaborators.

items.name: AppFlowy
items.descriptionZh: 开源的 Notion 类工作区，桌面与手机都有客户端，个人云端方案为 $0；也支持自建 AppFlowy Cloud，但要自己运维。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source Notion-style workspace with desktop and mobile clients and a $0 personal cloud plan; self-hosting AppFlowy Cloud is possible but is yours to operate.

items.name: Nuclino
items.descriptionZh: 偏团队维基的轻量协作空间，官方定价页写明免费档只包含少量文档与画布，超出即需升级。
items.descriptionEn: A lightweight team-wiki style workspace: its pricing page states the free plan covers only a small set of documents and canvases before you must upgrade.

items.name: Joplin
items.descriptionZh: 开源笔记，支持端到端加密与网页剪藏；软件免费，同步要用自己的网盘或自建 Joplin Server。
items.descriptionEn: Open-source notes with end-to-end encryption and web clipping; the app is free but syncing runs through your own cloud storage or a self-hosted Joplin Server.

items.name: Logseq
items.descriptionZh: 开源的大纲式双链笔记，数据存放在本地；官方仓库说明数据库版仍在 beta、存在丢数据可能，需要自己做好备份。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source outliner with backlinks that keeps data on your machine; the official repo says the database version is still beta with possible data loss, so backups are on you.

items.name: 思源笔记
items.descriptionZh: 开源、本地优先的块级笔记与知识库，页面和数据都在自己电脑上，可导出 Markdown；同步与备份由自己安排。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source, local-first block note and knowledge base: pages and data live on your own machine and export to Markdown, while syncing and backups are your own arrangement.

items.name: Anytype
items.descriptionZh: 本地优先、端到端加密的对象式工作区，定价页列有免费档；官方云空间额度较小，也可以完全离线使用。
items.descriptionEn: A local-first, end-to-end encrypted workspace built on objects, with a free plan on its pricing page; remote space on the official network is small and it also runs fully offline.

items.name: Standard Notes
items.descriptionZh: 端到端加密的笔记应用，免费档不限笔记数与设备数；表格、代码等进阶编辑器属于付费方案。
items.descriptionEn: An end-to-end encrypted notes app whose free plan has no note or device limits, while richer editors such as tables and code sit in the paid plans.

items.name: Zoho Notebook
items.descriptionZh: Zoho 的图文影音笔记，官方 FAQ 明确提供含 essential 功能的免费方案与有限云存储；深度使用可升级订阅。
items.descriptionEn: Zoho's rich-media note-taking app; its FAQ confirms a free plan with the essential features and capped cloud storage, with subscriptions for heavier use.

items.name: Evernote
items.descriptionZh: 老牌笔记与网页剪藏，官方对比页列有免费档，但笔记数量与每月上传量限制较紧；完整功能需订阅。
items.descriptionEn: The veteran note and web-clipping app: its compare-plans page lists a Free plan with tight note and monthly upload limits, and subscription for full features.

items.name: 印象笔记
items.descriptionZh: 国内的笔记与剪藏应用，官方定价页列有免费帐户，但上传流量与可同步设备数受限；更多设备与功能需按年购买会员。
items.descriptionEn: The China-based successor to Evernote's local product: its pricing page lists a free account with capped monthly upload and device sync, with annual membership for more.

items.name: Bear
items.descriptionZh: 只在 Mac、iPhone 与 iPad 上提供的 Markdown 笔记，免费档已含 iCloud 同步与多种导出；主题与进阶功能要订阅 Pro。
items.descriptionEn: A Markdown notes app limited to Mac, iPhone and iPad; the free tier already includes iCloud sync and many exports, while themes and extras need a Pro subscription.

items.name: Zoho Workplace
items.descriptionZh: 邮件、文档、表格、网盘成套的办公套件，按用户订阅；官方说明 macOS 与 Windows 同步客户端随订阅免费提供。
items.descriptionEn: A bundled office suite of mail, docs, sheets and storage priced per user, with the macOS and Windows sync clients included in the subscription per the vendor's own FAQ.

items.name: LibreOffice
items.descriptionZh: 开源办公套件，本机安装并兼容常见文档格式；它是桌面软件，不提供在线协同编辑。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source office suite installed on your machine and compatible with common document formats; it is desktop software and does not offer live co-editing.

items.name: CryptPad
items.descriptionZh: 端到端加密的文档、表格、幻灯片与白板协作，开源；官网有可直接打开使用的实例，也可自行部署。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source, end-to-end encrypted suite of documents, spreadsheets, slides and whiteboards; the official instance is open in the browser and you can also host your own.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多白板与流程图工具

items.name: Whimsical
items.descriptionZh: 白板、流程图、思维导图与线框图一体的产品向绘图工具，官方定价页列有 $0 免费档，适合产品团队快速表达。
items.descriptionEn: A product-oriented drawing tool combining whiteboards, flowcharts, mind maps and wireframes; its pricing page lists a $0 free plan, aimed at product teams sketching fast.

items.name: Mural
items.descriptionZh: 面向工作坊与团队共创的视觉协作平台，免费档不限制成员数，但同时可编辑的画板数量有限。
items.descriptionEn: A visual collaboration platform built for workshops; the free plan puts no cap on members but only a few murals stay editable at a time.

items.name: Boardmix 博思白板
items.descriptionZh: 国内的 AI 在线白板，集思维导图、流程图与团队共创，官网标注免费使用；更大容量与高级功能需付费。
items.descriptionEn: A China-based AI whiteboard covering mind maps, flow charts and team co-creation; the site advertises free use, with storage and advanced features behind paid plans.

items.name: ProcessOn
items.descriptionZh: 国内的在线作图工具，支持流程图、思维导图、UML、甘特图、组织结构图等多种图形与多人实时协作，官网标注免费注册使用。
items.descriptionEn: A China-based diagramming site for flowcharts, mind maps, UML, Gantt charts and org charts with real-time collaboration; the homepage advertises free registration.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多任务与项目管理工具

items.name: Basecamp
items.descriptionZh: 以项目为中心的团队沟通与待办，个人版一个项目永久免费；商业版按固定年费而非按人头收费，官网提供 30 天试用。
items.descriptionEn: Project-centred team chat and to-dos: the personal plan gives one project free forever, while business packages are a flat annual fee rather than per head, with a 30-day trial.

items.name: Smartsheet
items.descriptionZh: 表格化的企业项目管理与报表平台，官网入口是试用与演示，团队长期使用需按用户订阅。
items.descriptionEn: Spreadsheet-style enterprise project management and reporting, marketed through trials and demos and licensed per user for ongoing team use.

items.name: monday.com
items.descriptionZh: 看板式项目管理与轻流程平台，官方定价页列有 £0 永久免费档；可用席位、看板数与自动化额度都有限，超出需升级。
items.descriptionEn: A board-based project and workflow platform whose pricing page shows a £0 free-forever plan, capped on seats, boards and automations before you upgrade.

items.name: Habitica
items.descriptionZh: 把待办与习惯做成角色扮演游戏的开源应用，网页与移动端均可免费使用；项目由社区维护。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source app that turns to-dos and habits into a role-playing game, free on web and mobile and maintained by a community.

items.name: Taskade
items.descriptionZh: AI 优先的大纲、任务与思维导图工具，官网可直接免费注册开始，进阶的 AI 与自动化能力放在付费档。
items.descriptionEn: An AI-first outliner for tasks and mind maps you can start free from its homepage, with heavier AI and automation kept in paid tiers.

items.name: 飞书任务
items.descriptionZh: 飞书内置的任务与项目管理，支持甘特图与多人协作；随飞书账号使用，可用范围取决于所在版本。
items.descriptionEn: Task and project management built into Feishu, with Gantt views and shared lists; what you get depends on your Feishu edition.

items.name: SurveyMonkey
items.descriptionZh: 老牌问卷与调研平台，官方定价页保留 Basic 免费档；逻辑、分析与样本服务等多数能力要按年订阅。
items.descriptionEn: The long-running survey platform keeps a Basic free plan on its pricing page, but logic, analysis and sample services sit in annual subscriptions.

items.name: Typeform
items.descriptionZh: 以逐题作答的交互体验著称的表单工具，官网标注可免费开始；团队协作、集成与分析以订阅为主。
items.descriptionEn: A form builder known for one-question-at-a-time UX, advertised as free to start, while collaboration, integrations and analytics are subscription features.

items.name: 问卷星
items.descriptionZh: 国内老牌问卷与在线考试平台，官方版本对比列出 0 元/年的免费版；企业版与批量功能按年付费。
items.descriptionEn: A long-standing China-based survey and online-exam site whose version table lists a free plan at ¥0 a year, with enterprise versions billed annually.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多多维表格与低代码数据库

items.name: 简道云
items.descriptionZh: 企业级零代码应用搭建（表单、流程、报表与看板），官网入口以免费试用和商务咨询为主；长期团队使用需按版本订阅。
items.descriptionEn: An enterprise no-code builder for forms, workflows and dashboards; the site pushes trials and sales conversations, with per-version subscriptions for ongoing team use.

items.name: NocoDB
items.descriptionZh: 开源的"把数据库当表格用"工具，可以连自己的数据库自建，也有云端托管入口；自建需要运维。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source "database as a spreadsheet" tool you can point at your own database and self-host, with a hosted cloud entry as well; self-hosting means owning the ops.

items.name: Baserow
items.descriptionZh: 开源的在线数据库与表格搭建，云端有 $0 免费档，也可 Docker 自托管；免费档的行数与工作区数量有限。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source online database and app builder with a $0 cloud plan and Docker self-hosting, the free tier capped on rows and workspaces.

items.name: 飞书多维表格
items.descriptionZh: 飞书内置的多维表格与业务系统搭建，官方页面称其为 AI 驱动的表格与应用构建；随飞书账号使用，能力取决于所在版本。
items.descriptionEn: The database-table and light app builder built into Feishu, described on its official page as an AI-driven table platform; it rides on your Feishu account and edition.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多自动化与集成平台

items.name: Power Automate
items.descriptionZh: 微软的云端与桌面流程自动化，属于 Power Platform 付费体系；官网定价页把长期方案放在订阅里，高级功能提供 30 天试用。
items.descriptionEn: Microsoft's cloud and desktop flow automation inside the paid Power Platform: its pricing page puts ongoing use behind a subscription, with premium features free for 30 days.

items.name: n8n
items.descriptionZh: 开源的工作流自动化平台，自托管版本免费；官方云托管按订阅计费，定价页入口写的是免费试用。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source workflow automation platform that is free to self-host, while the hosted n8n Cloud is a subscription offered through a trial.

items.name: Activepieces
items.descriptionZh: 开源的自动化平台，官网写明免费方案不需要信用卡、流程数量不限，费用按流程实际运行次数计。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source automation tool whose free plan needs no card and allows unlimited flows, with billing driven by how often runs execute.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多日程与时间管理工具

items.name: Toggl Track
items.descriptionZh: 一键计时与工时统计，官方定价页列有 $0 免费档，适合自由职业者与小团队；团队报表与排班在付费档。
items.descriptionEn: One-click time tracking whose pricing page offers a $0 plan suited to freelancers and small teams, with team reporting and scheduling in the paid tiers.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多视频会议与录屏工具

items.name: Jitsi Meet
items.descriptionZh: 开源视频会议，可自行部署；官方演示服务器可直接开会，但 2026-10 公告称该服务器规则仍在调整，单场会议已设时长上限。
items.descriptionEn: Open-source video conferencing you can also self-host; the public demo server still hosts meetings, but an October 2026 notice says its rules are being changed and meetings now carry a duration cap.

items.name: Loom
items.descriptionZh: 录制屏幕与摄像头并直接生成分享链接，适合异步讲解；官网标注可免费获取。
items.descriptionEn: Records your screen and camera and instantly returns a share link for async walkthroughs; the site presents it as free to get.

items.name: Zulip
items.descriptionZh: 以话题组织的团队聊天，100% 开源；官方云有免费档，也可自建，开源项目、学术研究与小型非营利机构可申请免费标准版。
items.descriptionEn: Topic-organised team chat that is fully open source: the hosted cloud has a free plan, self-hosting is available, and open-source projects, research groups and small non-profits can apply for a free Standard plan.

items.name: Mattermost
items.descriptionZh: 开源自托管的团队消息与频道平台，常见于对内网与合规环境的要求；需要自己部署运维。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source, self-hosted messaging and channel platform frequently chosen for intranet and compliance environments, so deployment and upkeep are yours.

items.name: Rocket.Chat
items.descriptionZh: 开源团队聊天，官网写明可部署免费的自管理实例试用；核心之外的企业与安全功能属于付费版本。
items.descriptionEn: Open-source team chat whose site offers a free self-managed workspace to deploy; enterprise and security capabilities beyond the core come in paid editions.

items.name: 百度网盘 SVIP
items.descriptionZh: 官方会员页写明 SVIP 提供 5T 超大空间、下载提速、云解压转存与批量上传等更高上限。
items.descriptionEn: Baidu's membership page says SVIP adds 5 TB of space, faster downloads, cloud archive extraction and higher batch-upload limits.

items.name: 阿里云盘企业版
items.descriptionZh: 面向团队的网盘订阅，按人数与容量计价；官方活动页列出多档规格与年价，主打不限速与权限管理。
items.descriptionEn: A team-oriented drive billed by seats and capacity; Alibaba Cloud's promotion page lists several tiers and yearly prices, stressing unthrottled speed and permissions.

items.name: 蓝奏云
items.descriptionZh: 面向小文件分享的轻量网盘，官方登录页称总存储空间不限量、分享免登录且不限速；从海外网络直接访问该域名多次超时，可用性需自行确认。
items.descriptionEn: A lightweight drive aimed at small-file sharing; its sign-in page promises unlimited total space, login-free links and no speed caps, though the domain timed out repeatedly from outside China.

items.name: 蓝奏云优享版
items.descriptionZh: 蓝奏团队的另一条产品线，官方承诺普通用户上传下载永不限速；免登录下载只开放 100MB 以内的分享文件，更大上限属于 VIP。
items.descriptionEn: A second Lanzou product line that promises permanent no-throttling for ordinary users; login-free downloads cover shared files up to 100 MB, with larger files reserved for VIP.

items.name: 中国移动云盘
items.descriptionZh: 运营商网盘，官方介绍页称上传下载不限速、注册初始空间 20G，PC 同步盘可免费体验，会员另有 2T 空间；境外使用条件未核实。
items.descriptionEn: A carrier-run drive whose overview promises unthrottled uploads and downloads, 20 GB to start and a free trial of the PC sync client, with 2 TB for members; conditions for users outside China were not verifiable.

items.name: 迅雷云盘
items.descriptionZh: 迅雷旗下网盘；未登录的网页端即显示 2TB 容量额度并挂着开通会员入口，免费档的具体条件要登录后才能确认。
items.descriptionEn: Xunlei's drive; the logged-out web client already shows a 2 TB allowance next to a membership button, so the real terms of the free tier only appear after signing in.

items.name: Cloudreve
items.descriptionZh: 开源自托管网盘程序，官方简介为“部署公私兼备的网盘系统”；需要自备服务器与域名才能使用。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source, self-hosted drive billed as a system for both public and private deployments, so it needs your own server and domain.

items.name: OpenList
items.descriptionZh: AList 的分叉，把多家网盘聚合成一个文件列表与 WebDAV 服务；AGPL-3.0 开源、需自行部署，官方声明提醒下游项目不要冒用其名。
items.descriptionEn: A fork of AList that merges several cloud drives into one file list and WebDAV endpoint; AGPL-3.0, self-hosted, and its notice warns downstream projects against using its name.

items.name: Box
items.descriptionZh: 面向企业的文件管理与协作平台，官网主打企业内容管理与电子签名；本次抓取未能打开其定价页，个人免费方案条件待核实。
items.descriptionEn: An enterprise content-management and collaboration platform whose site leads with business workflows and e-signatures; its pricing page could not be fetched, so the personal free terms stay unverified.

items.name: IDrive
items.descriptionZh: 以备份为主的云存储，官网按年订阅列出 1TB 起的价格与首年折扣，卖点是一次备份多台设备与多个云端服务。
items.descriptionEn: Backup-first cloud storage listed by yearly subscription from 1 TB, with a first-year discount and multi-device backup as the pitch.

items.name: MediaFire
items.descriptionZh: 老牌网盘，官方首页写明免费存 10GB、叠加奖励可到 50GB，习惯用法是把文件做成分享链接。
items.descriptionEn: A long-running drive whose homepage states 10 GB free, extendable to 50 GB through bonuses, and is mostly used to hand out download links.

items.name: TeraBox
items.descriptionZh: 官网标题写称提供高达 1TB 的免费云存储并可在线发送大文件；页面为前端渲染，条款与限速政策本次未能核实。
items.descriptionEn: Its page title claims up to 1 TB of free cloud storage plus online large-file sending, but the site renders client-side, so terms and speed policies stayed unverified this pass.

items.name: NordLocker
items.descriptionZh: 端到端加密网盘，官网称免费版含 3GB 云空间、付费档升至 2TB；加密在设备端完成。
items.descriptionEn: An end-to-end encrypted drive whose site puts 3 GB of cloud space on the free plan and up to 2 TB on the paid one, with encryption handled on your device.

items.name: Icedrive
items.descriptionZh: 主打加密的网盘，官网称注册即送 10GB 免费空间；页面显示运营主体为直布罗陀的 Ice Privacy LTD，免费之外是个人与家庭付费档。
items.descriptionEn: An encryption-led drive that advertises 10 GB free on sign-up; its site names Ice Privacy LTD in Gibraltar as the operator and sells individual and family plans beyond the free tier.

items.name: HiDrive
items.descriptionZh: 德国 STRATO 旗下网盘，官方产品页把访问方式列为 SFTP、WebDAV、SMB、rsync、SCP 与 Git，并写明 WebDAV 与 SMB 包含在 Business Essential、Standard 及以上套餐里；本轮只读到德语页这一段，价格与免费档未核。
items.descriptionEn: A German drive from STRATO whose product page lists SFTP, WebDAV, SMB, rsync, SCP and Git as access methods and says WebDAV and SMB come with the Business Essential and Standard tiers or above; only that German-language passage was read this pass, so pricing and any free plan stayed unverified.

items.name: Nextcloud
items.descriptionZh: 开源自建网盘与协作套件，官方手册写明完整支持 WebDAV，第三方客户端走 /remote.php/dav/files/；需自备服务器，Windows 映射网络盘还有单文件大小上限等已知限制。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source suite whose manual says WebDAV is fully supported, with third-party clients pointed at /remote.php/dav/files/; you run the server yourself, and Windows drive mapping carries known limits such as a per-file size cap.

items.name: Seafile
items.descriptionZh: 开源自建网盘，官方提供 WebDAV 扩展接口，默认路径 /seafdav；手册同时提醒，把它映射成本地磁盘性能有限，大批量上传比同步客户端慢。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source private drive with an official WebDAV extension served at /seafdav; its manual warns that mapping it as a local disk performs poorly and that bulk uploads are slower than the sync client.

items.name: MyDrive
items.descriptionZh: 瑞士厂商的网盘，数据可选存放在瑞士或欧盟，官网称可免费注册并长期试用；官网另列 MyDrive WebDAV，称文件通过云端 WebDAV 目录自动同步，能在 Windows 资源管理器、macOS Finder 与 Linux 里当本地盘直接编辑。
items.descriptionEn: A Swiss drive that keeps data in Switzerland or the EU, offers free registration with an open-ended trial, and documents MyDrive WebDAV separately: files sync through a WebDAV folder in the cloud and open in Windows Explorer, macOS Finder or Linux like a local disk.

items.name: rclone
items.descriptionZh: 命令行工具，能把各家网盘挂成本地盘，也能反过来对外提供 WebDAV、SFTP 与 FTP；本身不存文件，要在自己电脑上运行。
items.descriptionEn: A command-line tool that mounts remote drives as a local disk and can itself serve WebDAV, SFTP and FTP; it stores nothing on its own and runs on your machine.

items.name: RaiDrive
items.descriptionZh: 把云存储挂成 Windows 或 Linux 盘符的桌面工具，官方定价页列有带广告的免费 Standard 档，WebDAV、SFTP 与 FTP 可写。
items.descriptionEn: A desktop tool that mounts cloud storage as a Windows or Linux drive letter; its pricing page lists an ad-supported free Standard plan, with WebDAV, SFTP and FTP writable.

items.name: Wormhole
items.descriptionZh: 端到端加密的临时文件传输，页面写明单文件最大 10GB、链接自动过期；该页未直接声明长期免费。
items.descriptionEn: End-to-end encrypted ephemeral transfer, capped at 10 GB per file with self-expiring links; the page does not state that it stays free indefinitely.

items.name: Tmp.Ninja
items.descriptionZh: 免注册的临时文件托管，页面写明免费、保存 48 小时、单文件 10GB，并表示按 DMCA 通知下架。
items.descriptionEn: Registration-free temporary hosting described as free, with a 48-hour lifetime and a 10 GB file cap, and DMCA takedowns honoured.

items.name: send
items.descriptionZh: Firefox Send 的社区延续版，自托管后就是自己的大文件传输站；仓库说明列出了公共实例清单。
items.descriptionEn: A community continuation of Firefox Send: self-host it and you run your own large-file site; the repository also lists public instances.

items.name: Envato Elements
items.descriptionZh: 订阅制素材库，官方页写有 3000 万以上资产、覆盖视频/图片/音乐/字体，并提供“终身商用授权”，下载需保持订阅。
items.descriptionEn: A subscription asset library advertising 30M+ assets across video, images, music and fonts with a lifetime commercial licence; downloading requires an active plan.

items.name: Freepik
items.descriptionZh: 老牌的图片、矢量与模板素材站，本轮打开时首页标题已写作“Freepik is now Magnific”，转为按额度计费的订阅与 AI 生成平台。
items.descriptionEn: A long-running stock graphics site whose homepage now reads “Freepik is now Magnific”, positioned as a credit-based subscription with AI generation.

items.name: Phosphor Icons
items.descriptionZh: 风格成套的开源图标家族，GitHub 上的 core 仓库标注 MIT 授权；官网为动态渲染，本轮未能读到站内授权文字。
items.descriptionEn: A family of consistent open-source icons; the phosphor-icons/core repository is labelled MIT, while the site itself showed no licence text in this check.

items.name: Feather Icons
items.descriptionZh: 简洁线性图标集，官方仓库标注 MIT 授权、约 2.6 万星标，自述为“Simply beautiful open-source icons”。
items.descriptionEn: A simple line-icon set; the official repository is labelled MIT with about 26k stars and calls itself “Simply beautiful open-source icons”.

items.name: Material Design Icons
items.descriptionZh: 社区维护的 Material Design 风格图标仓库，仓库简介写有 7000+ 图标；GitHub 许可标识为 Other，具体条款要读仓库内文件。
items.descriptionEn: A community repository of Material Design-style icons described as 7000+ icons; the GitHub licence field reads “Other”, so the bundled terms must be read.

items.name: iconfont 阿里巴巴矢量图标库
items.descriptionZh: 页面标题自述为“阿里巴巴矢量图标库”的图标搜索与下载站，内容以符号与项目形式取用；单个图标的授权需在使用前自行核对。
items.descriptionEn: An icon search and download site whose own page title calls itself Alibaba's vector icon library; check the licence of each icon before use.

items.name: Storyset
items.descriptionZh: 以免费插画为主的站点，首页写明可自定义、做动画并下载；本轮没有读到完整的整站授权条款。
items.descriptionEn: A free illustration site whose homepage offers customising, animating and downloading; a complete site-wide licence was not read in this check.

items.name: FreeSVG.org
items.descriptionZh: SVG 矢量素材站，站内说明作品以 CC0 公有领域授权，可复制、修改并商用而无需许可。
items.descriptionEn: An SVG vector library whose pages state that files carry the CC0 public-domain licence, so copying, modifying and commercial use need no permission.

items.name: Openclipart
items.descriptionZh: 公有领域剪贴画社区，首页提供 License 说明页入口；本轮只读到导航文字，未读到该页正文。
items.descriptionEn: A public-domain clipart community linking a Licence page from its homepage; only the navigation text was readable during this check.

items.name: Monotype
items.descriptionZh: 商业字体授权与企业字体管理平台，官方页以“Discover, evaluate, license, and deploy”描述其字体库，属付费订阅服务。
items.descriptionEn: A commercial font licensing and enterprise font-management platform described as “discover, evaluate, license, and deploy”, sold as a paid service.

items.name: 思源黑体 Source Han Sans
items.descriptionZh: Adobe 维护的中文黑体字库仓库，简介列出简体、繁体、日文、韩文与可变字体，约 1.7 万星标；GitHub 许可标识为 Other，条款需读仓库内授权文件。
items.descriptionEn: The Adobe-maintained Chinese sans-serif repository, listing Simplified, Traditional, Japanese and Korean variants plus variable fonts; the GitHub licence field reads “Other”, so the bundled licence file must be read.

items.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
items.descriptionZh: 订阅制的专业创意套件，官方页列出 20 多个应用并提供免费试用入口，正式使用需按套餐付费。
items.descriptionEn: A subscription creative suite; the official page lists 20+ apps and a free-trial entry, with paid plans for continued use.

items.name: GIMP
items.descriptionZh: GNU 图像编辑程序，属桌面软件，需自行下载安装，官网没有网页版。
items.descriptionEn: A desktop image editor from the GNU project that you install yourself; there is no hosted version.

items.name: CGTrader
items.descriptionZh: 3D 模型交易市场，官方页说明按用途分级的授权条款，站内同时提供免费模型分区。
items.descriptionEn: A 3D model marketplace whose page describes licensing options by use case, alongside a free-model section.

items.name: Kenney
items.descriptionZh: 游戏美术素材站，素材按 2D/3D/UI/音频等类别浏览，另有 All-in-1 打包下载并写明包含免费更新。
items.descriptionEn: A game-asset site with packs sorted by 2D, 3D, UI and audio categories, plus an all-in-one bundle that includes free updates.

items.name: Quaternius
items.descriptionZh: 低多边形游戏素材站，站名自述为 “Free Game Assets”，导航里有 License 页；本轮未读到该页正文。
items.descriptionEn: A low-poly game asset site branded “Free Game Assets” with a License page in its navigation; that page's text was not captured in this check.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多文件与 PDF 工具

items.name: Adobe Acrobat Online
items.descriptionZh: PDF 发明方的在线工具，官方页写有“Access free Acrobat online tools to convert, share, fill, and sign documents”，同时以免费试用引导订阅完整版。
items.descriptionEn: The tooling from the company that invented PDF; its page offers “free Acrobat online tools to convert, share, fill, and sign documents” while pushing a trial of the paid full product.

items.name: Smallpdf
items.descriptionZh: 定价页把免费档写成“有限下载量、有限移动端访问”，Pro 档才是不限 30 多个工具，页面同时以免费试用引导订阅。
items.descriptionEn: The pricing page lists the free account as limited document downloads and limited mobile access, with Pro unlocking all 30+ tools, while the site pushes a free trial.

items.name: Sejda
items.descriptionZh: 网页端与桌面端都能编辑 PDF，官方定价页按周或按月出售网页版与桌面版套餐。
items.descriptionEn: Edits PDFs in the browser and on the desktop, with weekly and monthly plans for each sold on the official pricing page.

items.name: CloudConvert
items.descriptionZh: 支持 200 多种格式的网页转换服务，官方定价页写明免费额度是每天 10 次转换、无需信用卡。
items.descriptionEn: A browser converter for 200+ formats; the pricing page states the free allowance is 10 conversions a day with no credit card.

items.name: Convertio
items.descriptionZh: 浏览器里的多格式转换站，官方说明所有用户都有免费档，付费套餐按每月转换额度计费。
items.descriptionEn: A browser-based converter whose pricing page says a free tier is available to all users, with paid plans sold as monthly conversion credits.

items.name: TinyWow
items.descriptionZh: 文件、PDF、图片与 AI 写作工具集合，免费使用但带广告与验证码，付费档去掉这两项并提高处理优先级。
items.descriptionEn: A bundle of file, PDF, image and AI writing tools that is free with ads and CAPTCHAs, while the paid plan removes both and prioritises processing.

items.name: Cleanup.pictures
items.descriptionZh: 在浏览器里抹掉照片中的物体、文字与瑕疵，官方定价页写明免费档不限张数但分辨率限 720p，高清属付费 Pro。
items.descriptionEn: Removes objects, text and defects in the browser; the official pricing page caps the free plan at 720p resolution with unlimited images, leaving full resolution to Pro.

items.name: OCR.space
items.descriptionZh: 官方页写明在线 OCR 免注册即可使用，并支持生成可搜索 PDF；免费档单文件限 5 MB，另有免费 API 额度。
items.descriptionEn: The official page says online OCR needs no registration and can build searchable PDFs, with a 5 MB per-file free limit and a separate free API allowance.

items.name: W3C Markup Validation Service
items.descriptionZh: W3C 官方的网页标记校验服务，可按网址、上传文件或直接粘贴代码检查，页面免费使用。
items.descriptionEn: W3C's official markup checker, free to use by URI, file upload or direct input of the code.

items.name: Can I use
items.descriptionZh: 前端特性在各浏览器上的支持情况查询表，站内自述为“up-to-date browser support tables”。
items.descriptionEn: Browser support tables for front-end web technologies, described on the site as “up-to-date browser support tables”.

items.name: CyberChef
items.descriptionZh: 英国政府通信总部 GCHQ 开源的编解码与数据分析工作台，官方页说明它没有服务端组件、下载 ZIP 解压即可自建（仓库标 Apache-2.0），同页也提醒非官方版本可能被改成窃取输入与配方。
items.descriptionEn: An encoding, hashing and data-analysis workbench open-sourced by the UK's GCHQ; the official page says it has no server-side component and runs from an unzipped download (the repository is Apache-2.0), and warns that unofficial copies could be modified to exfiltrate input and recipes.

items.name: BrowserLeaks
items.descriptionZh: 检测 IP、WebRTC、Canvas 与字体指纹等浏览器可能泄露的信息，网页免费查看结果。
items.descriptionEn: Checks what a browser may leak — IP, WebRTC, canvas and font fingerprints — with free results shown in the page.

items.name: Open-Meteo
items.descriptionZh: 开源天气数据接口，官方定价页写明非商用免费、无需 API key，但需署名且有每分钟调用上限，适合自建查询而非看预报。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source weather API whose pricing page makes non-commercial use free with no API key, but requires attribution and caps calls per minute, suiting builders rather than forecast readers.

items.name: 即时工具
items.descriptionZh: 中文在线工具箱，首页列出视频、音频、图片、文档转换、二维码与单位换算等工具，同时设有定价、会员特价与客户端入口。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese online toolbox listing video, audio, image, document-conversion, QR-code and unit tools on its homepage, alongside pricing, membership and desktop-app entries.

items.name: 在线工具集
items.descriptionZh: 自述“纯前端 · 隐私优先 · 完全免费”的中文工具箱，称有 80 多个图片、换算、文档与文本工具、数据不离开本地；本轮未查到运营主体，长期维护情况待观察。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese toolbox branding itself “client-side, privacy-first, completely free”, claiming 80+ image, conversion, document and text tools that never leave the browser; the operator was not identified in this check, so its longevity is unproven.

items.name: Dailymotion
items.descriptionZh: 视频分享平台，与 YouTube 同类；本轮只取到页面标题，正文为脚本渲染，内容授权与广告情况未核。
items.descriptionEn: A video-sharing platform in the YouTube mould; only the page title came back because the body is script-rendered, so its licensing and ad situation are unverified.

items.name: Twitch
items.descriptionZh: 以游戏直播为主的视频平台，本轮只取到标题“Twitch”，免费观看与频道订阅的分界未取证。
items.descriptionEn: A live-streaming platform centred on games; only the title “Twitch” came back, so the boundary between free watching and channel subscriptions is unverified.

items.name: niconico
items.descriptionZh: 日本弹幕视频与直播社区（ニコニコ），取到了動画/静画/生放送导航，但页面同时提示“コンテンツの取得に失敗しました”，海外可看范围与会员分界未核。
items.descriptionEn: Japan's danmaku video and live community; the 動画/静画/生放送 navigation came through together with a “コンテンツの取得に失敗しました” notice, so availability outside Japan and membership limits are unverified.

items.name: Disney+
items.descriptionZh: 美国站首页标价“Starting at $11.99/mo”的组合档，并区分有广告与无广告方案；内容与价格随地区变化。
items.descriptionEn: Its US homepage lists “Starting at $11.99/mo” for bundled plans and separates with-ads from no-ads tiers; content and pricing vary by region.

items.name: Prime Video
items.descriptionZh: 亚马逊影视服务，导航里有“Free to me”专区，但示例条目写明需 Prime 会员或“30 day free Prime trial, auto renews at £8.99/month”，并非长期免费。
items.descriptionEn: Amazon's video service has a “Free to me” menu, yet sample titles note a Prime membership or a “30 day free Prime trial, auto renews at £8.99/month”, so access is subscription-bound rather than permanently free.

items.name: The Roku Channel
items.descriptionZh: Roku 的免费影视频道，各类清单常把它列为免费平台，但本轮访问被重定向到 /enguard/en-gb 且正文只剩 4 个字符，可看范围与服务条件未能核实。
items.descriptionEn: Roku's free channel, routinely listed among free platforms, but this visit redirected to /enguard/en-gb and returned four characters, so its catalogue and terms could not be checked.

moreCollections.titleZh: 更多公共媒体与开放片库

items.name: PBS
items.descriptionZh: 美国公共广播电视网，首页要先“Choose Station”选地方台并创建账号；节目多为免费，但部分条目仅限对应地区。
items.descriptionEn: U.S. public broadcasting; the homepage asks you to “Choose Station” and create an account, and while much of the catalogue is free, some programmes stay station- or region-limited.

items.name: Kanopy
items.descriptionZh: 自述“Stream thousands of films for free, thanks to the generous support of your public library or university”，免费前提是持有合作公共图书馆借书证或大学账号，并标称无广告。
items.descriptionEn: It says “Stream thousands of films for free, thanks to the generous support of your public library or university” — free only with a partner library card or university login, and advertised as ad-free.

items.name: SBS On Demand
items.descriptionZh: 澳大利亚特别广播服务公司的点播平台，页面标题即“Watch Free Movies and TV Shows Online | Stream Free on SBS On Demand”；海外可用范围本轮未核。
items.descriptionEn: Australia's SBS on-demand service, titled “Watch Free Movies and TV Shows Online | Stream Free on SBS On Demand”; availability outside Australia was not checked.

items.name: CBC Gem
items.descriptionZh: 加拿大广播公司的免费点播平台，首页多处标注“This content is only available to our signed in members”，部分内容需先登录。
items.descriptionEn: Canada's free on-demand service, whose homepage repeatedly notes “This content is only available to our signed in members”, so part of the catalogue needs a login first.

items.name: ABC iview
items.descriptionZh: 澳大利亚广播公司的回看平台，自述“Watch all your favourite ABC programs on ABC iview”，并含各州直播频道；本轮未取到地区限制的原文。
items.descriptionEn: Australia's ABC catch-up service, “Watch all your favourite ABC programs on ABC iview”, with live state channels; no geo-restriction wording was captured this round.

items.name: ARD Mediathek
items.descriptionZh: 德国公共广播联合体的媒体库，标题自述“Filme, Serien und Dokus online anschauen”，界面为德语。
items.descriptionEn: The media library of Germany's public broadcasters, titled “Filme, Serien und Dokus online anschauen”, with a German-language interface.

items.name: 央视频
items.descriptionZh: 中央广播电视总台官方平台，浏览器读取首页可见“推荐/电视/赛事”导航与“精彩直播，等你来看”的轮播标题，以频道直播与体育赛事为主；整页没有写明免费与付费的分界。
items.descriptionEn: The official platform of China's state broadcast centre; reading its homepage in a browser shows 推荐/电视/赛事 navigation and a “精彩直播，等你来看” carousel headline built around TV streams and live sport, with no stated free-versus-paid boundary.

items.name: Apple Music
items.descriptionZh: 苹果音乐订阅服务，官方页写明个人档“just $11.99 per month after your free trial”、学生档 $6.99，只提供试用而非长期免费。
items.descriptionEn: Apple's subscription music service; the official page gives $11.99 per month after a free trial for individuals and $6.99 for students, i.e. a trial rather than a lasting free tier.

items.name: YouTube Music
items.descriptionZh: YouTube 的音乐服务，本轮只取到标题“YouTube Music”，正文为脚本渲染，免费带广告与 Premium 的分界未取证。
items.descriptionEn: YouTube's music service; only the title “YouTube Music” came back, so the ad-supported-versus-Premium boundary is unverified.

items.name: Amazon Music
items.descriptionZh: 亚马逊音乐入口，本轮页面只返回“Tuning in”的加载壳，免费层与 Prime 权益的关系未能核实。
items.descriptionEn: Amazon's music entry point, which returned only a “Tuning in” loading shell, so its free layer and Prime entitlement are unverified.

items.name: 网易云音乐
items.descriptionZh: 国内音乐平台，登录框自述“没有账号？免费注册”，同时设有 VIP 会员；哪些曲目需要会员本轮未逐项核实。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese music platform whose sign-in panel says “没有账号？免费注册” while also selling VIP membership; which tracks require membership was not checked.

items.name: QQ音乐
items.descriptionZh: 站内标题自述“千万正版音乐”，页面同时给出开通 VIP、超级会员与绿钻豪华版入口，免费可听范围本轮未核。
items.descriptionEn: Self-described as holding “千万正版音乐”, with entries for VIP, Super Member and the 绿钻 tier; the free listening scope was not verified.

items.name: 咪咕音乐
items.descriptionZh: 中国移动的音乐平台，本轮只取到标题“咪咕音乐”，去标签正文只剩 4 个字，免费与会员条件未核。
items.descriptionEn: China Mobile's music service; only the title came back (four characters of body text), so its free and membership terms are unverified.

items.name: Audiomack
items.descriptionZh: 以说唱、电子与非洲曲风为主的上传型音乐平台，首页可自由浏览与收听，另在顶部提供“Get Plus”订阅。
items.descriptionEn: An upload-driven music platform centred on rap, electronic and African genres, browsable and listenable from its homepage next to a “Get Plus” subscription.

moreCollections.group: 开放授权与公共领域音频

items.name: ccMixter
items.descriptionZh: 以混音与采样为核心的社区曲库，写明“you can use our music for free in your social media videos! Just give us credit”，站点自身文字为 CC BY-NC 4.0。
items.descriptionEn: A remix-and-sample community library that says “you can use our music for free in your social media videos! Just give us credit”; the site's own text is CC BY-NC 4.0.

items.name: Incompetech
items.descriptionZh: Kevin MacLeod 的免版税音乐库，站内导航为“Royalty-Free Music / Music Licenses”，并提供一次性下载全部文件。
items.descriptionEn: Kevin MacLeod's royalty-free music library, navigated as “Royalty-Free Music / Music Licenses”, with an option to download all files at once.

items.name: Internet Archive Audio
items.descriptionZh: 互联网档案馆的音频分区，站点自述收录“Free & Borrowable ... Music”；页面为脚本渲染，逐条目的授权需另行查看。
items.descriptionEn: The audio section of the Internet Archive, whose site banner promises “Free & Borrowable ... Music”; the page is script-rendered, so licensing has to be read per item.

items.name: Radio Garden
items.descriptionZh: 以旋转地球探索全球电台的网页应用，标题自述“Explore live radio by rotating the globe”；去标签正文只剩 55 字，内容靠图形渲染。
items.descriptionEn: A globe-spinning web app for exploring live radio worldwide, titled “Explore live radio by rotating the globe”; only 55 characters of body text came back because it renders graphically.

items.name: TuneIn
items.descriptionZh: 网络电台与播客聚合站，标题写明“Free Internet Radio”，定价表列出 Free £0.00/月与 Premium £7.99/月两档。
items.descriptionEn: An internet radio and podcast aggregator titled “Free Internet Radio”, with a pricing table listing Free at £0.00 a month and Premium at £7.99 a month.

items.name: Pocket Casts
items.descriptionZh: 播客客户端与网页播放器；本轮访问其播客页面被重定向到登录页，标题只剩“Web Player - Pocket Casts”，网页版是否需要账号、免费与付费如何分界均未取证。
items.descriptionEn: A podcast client and web player; this visit to its podcasts page redirected to a login screen titled “Web Player - Pocket Casts”, so whether the web player needs an account and where the free/paid line sits are unverified.

items.name: AntennaPod
items.descriptionZh: 开源播客播放器，官方页写明“built by volunteers without commercial interest”且“The AntennaPod application itself does not contain ads”，需要在安卓等端自行安装。
items.descriptionEn: An open-source podcast player whose official page says it is “built by volunteers without commercial interest” and “The AntennaPod application itself does not contain ads”; you install it on Android or desktop yourself.

items.name: 小宇宙
items.descriptionZh: 中文播客平台，站内标语“听播客，上小宇宙”，页面另给“主播后台”与客户端下载入口；去标签正文只剩 29 字，免费收听与单集付费的分界本轮未取到。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese podcast platform with the tagline “听播客，上小宇宙” and links to its creator console and app downloads; only 29 characters of body text came back, so where free listening ends and paid episodes begin was not captured.

items.name: 喜马拉雅
items.descriptionZh: 国内音频分享平台，首页自述“国内专业音频分享平台”，同时列出“开通会员”与“7天免费畅听 10万本会员专辑”，即免费畅听属限时试用而会员专辑需订阅。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese audio platform self-described as a professional audio-sharing site, which offers “开通会员” and a “7天免费畅听 10万本会员专辑” trial — the free listening is time-limited while member albums need a subscription.

items.name: Audible
items.descriptionZh: 亚马逊的有声书订阅服务，英国站定价页写“Audible Premium is £8.99 per month”，新会员前 30 天免费、到期自动扣费；用现金或积分购入的专辑在退订后仍归你。
items.descriptionEn: Amazon's audiobook subscription; its UK pricing page lists “Audible Premium is £8.99 per month” with a 30-day trial that auto-renews, while titles bought with cash or credits stay yours after you cancel.

items.name: Everand
items.descriptionZh: 原 Scribd 改名，把有声书、电子书与播客打包成订阅，首页写“Read free for 30 days”“From £10.99/month after trial”，每月可解锁的书量按套餐分档。
items.descriptionEn: The former Scribd, bundling audiobooks, e-books and podcasts into a subscription that says “Read free for 30 days” and “From £10.99/month after trial”, with unlocks varying by plan.

items.name: LibriVox
items.descriptionZh: 志愿者朗读的公共领域有声书，首页自述“free public domain audiobooks”，并称可免费收听或刻盘；2026-09-16 的站内新闻说目录“has grown to include more than 21,000 completed projects”。
items.descriptionEn: Volunteer-read public-domain audiobooks, free to listen to or burn onto a CD; a news item dated 16 September 2026 says the catalog “has grown to include more than 21,000 completed projects”.

items.name: Libby
items.descriptionZh: 公共图书馆的官方借阅应用，首页写“Thousands of public libraries offer ebooks and audiobooks (for free!) in Libby”，需要用本地图书馆借书证登录，书目由图书馆采购。
items.descriptionEn: The library borrowing app, whose homepage says “Thousands of public libraries offer ebooks and audiobooks (for free!) in Libby”; you sign in with a local library card and the shelf is whatever your library buys.

items.name: Library of Congress
items.descriptionZh: 美国国会图书馆，站内“Free to Use and Reuse”专页汇总可自由复用的藏品，多数数字化资源无需账号即可浏览，逐件版权另看条目说明。
items.descriptionEn: The US national library, whose “Free to Use and Reuse” page gathers material cleared for reuse; most digitised collections browse without an account, with rights stated per item.

items.name: Europeana
items.descriptionZh: 聚合欧洲各国机构藏品的数字文化遗产门户，标题自述“Discover Europe's digital cultural heritage”；页面靠脚本渲染，逐件藏品的授权要回原机构页面查看。
items.descriptionEn: Europe's aggregated heritage portal, titled “Discover Europe's digital cultural heritage”; the page is script-rendered and each object's licensing is read at the holding institution.

items.name: DPLA
items.descriptionZh: 美国图书馆与档案馆的聚合检索门户，首页称可“Discover 53,365,391 images, texts, videos, and sounds”，自身不托管内容，点开后进各机构站点。
items.descriptionEn: A US aggregation portal that invites you to “Discover 53,365,391 images, texts, videos, and sounds”; it hosts nothing itself and links out to the holding institutions.

items.name: 中国国家图书馆
items.descriptionZh: 国家图书馆的数字资源入口，官方页说明“读者云门户”提供在线阅读与播放，需注册登录；其古籍平台自述提供“开放共享、全面多元的古籍资源”。
items.descriptionEn: The National Library of China's digital doorway, whose reader portal offers online reading and playback once you register, and whose classic-text platform describes itself as open and shared.

items.name: 书格
items.descriptionZh: 自由开放的中文数字图书馆，首页自述“让大家自由、免费地欣赏到那些难以现世的书籍与字画”，新版已发布 761 套精选资源，多为古籍善本与字画的扫描图。
items.descriptionEn: An independent Chinese digital library that lets people enjoy rare books and paintings freely and free of charge, with 761 curated sets published, mostly scans of classic books and paintings.

items.name: Project Gutenberg Australia
items.descriptionZh: 澳洲分站的志愿者电子书库，首页写明“All books are in the 'public domain' in Australia and all have been prepared by volunteers”，版权判定依澳大利亚法律而非美国。
items.descriptionEn: The Australian branch's volunteer e-text library, stating “All books are in the 'public domain' in Australia” - the copyright test is Australian law, not US.

items.name: Faded Page
items.descriptionZh: 加拿大的免费电子书站，首页称“FP now includes 9182 eBooks”，并提醒站内书作按加拿大著作权法进入公共领域，他国读者需自行核对。
items.descriptionEn: Canada's free e-book site, saying “FP now includes 9182 eBooks” and warning that titles are public domain under Canadian law, so readers elsewhere must check their own.

items.name: Google Books
items.descriptionZh: 谷歌图书检索站，标题为“Find, Preview, and Read Books Online”；能否看到全文取决于版权状态与所在地区，多数条目只提供试读。
items.descriptionEn: Google's book search, titled “Find, Preview, and Read Books Online”; full text depends on copyright status and your country, and most records are previews.

items.name: 识典古籍
items.descriptionZh: 中文古籍整理站，导航含检索、目录与 App 听读；本轮抓取的首页与关于页都未出现官方“免费/开放”表述，授权与费用仍需核实。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese classics site offering search, catalogue and in-app listening; neither the home page nor the about page captured this round states an official “free/open” claim, so its licensing and cost stay unverified.

items.name: 万方数据
items.descriptionZh: 中文文献数据库，首页主推“万方会员 登录/注册”“机构登录”，另列个人用户文献检测、职称评审等付费服务；不付费能检索到多少本轮未取证。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese literature database whose homepage leads with member sign-up, institutional login and paid similarity-check or appraisal services; how much stays free without a subscription was not captured.

items.name: CORE
items.descriptionZh: 聚合开放获取论文的检索平台，标题自述“The world's largest collection of open access research papers”，全文链接指向各来源库。
