items.descriptionEn: An aggregator titled “The world's largest collection of open access research papers”, which links out to the source repositories.

items.name: Zenodo
items.descriptionZh: CERN 运营的开放存储库，论文、数据集与软件可存并领取 DOI；本轮抓取的首页没有费用表述，但公告了定期维护停机时段。
items.descriptionEn: The open repository run by CERN, where papers, datasets and software can be deposited and given DOIs; the captured homepage states no price but does announce maintenance downtime.

items.name: OpenAlex
items.descriptionZh: 开放的研究元数据目录，首页写明“a free and open catalog of the world's research”，并提供可直接调用的 API，本身不托管论文全文。
items.descriptionEn: A “free and open catalog of the world's research” with a callable API; it indexes research metadata rather than hosting the papers.

items.name: DOAB
items.descriptionZh: 开放获取学术专著目录，官方页写明“All DOAB services are free of charge and all data is freely available”，阅读需跳到出版社页面。
items.descriptionEn: A directory of open-access academic books stating “All DOAB services are free of charge and all data is freely available”; reading happens at the publisher.

items.name: bioRxiv
items.descriptionZh: 生物学预印本平台，标题自述“the preprint server for Biology”，全文开放可读，但稿件未经同行评审。
items.descriptionEn: The biology preprint server, titled “the preprint server for Biology”; papers are openly readable but have not been peer-reviewed.

items.name: ChinaXiv
items.descriptionZh: 中国科学院的科技论文预发布平台，首页显示“论文总量 48106”，并称“发布后本平台实行开放的后评议”。
items.descriptionEn: The Chinese Academy of Sciences' preprint server, showing “论文总量 48106” and running open post-publication review.

items.name: OpenAIRE
items.descriptionZh: 欧盟的开放科学基础设施，检索欧洲资助成果并提供开放获取合规指引；本轮抓到的页面以服务介绍为主，是否需登录才能检索未核对。
items.descriptionEn: Europe's open-science infrastructure for finding funded research and compliance guidance; the captured page is service description, so whether search needs an account was not checked.

items.name: edX
items.descriptionZh: 大学课程平台，首页写“Register for a free account”，帮助中心另有“How to Audit a Course”与验证证书说明，即旁听免费、证书另购。
items.descriptionEn: University courses with a “Register for a free account” home page and help articles on auditing courses and paid verified certificates - auditing is free, the certificate is not.

items.name: OpenLearn
items.descriptionZh: 英国开放大学的免费学习站，首页称“Everything on the multi-award winning OpenLearn is free to everyone!”，注册免费账号才能选课并领免费数字徽章。
items.descriptionEn: The Open University's learning site, saying “Everything on the multi-award winning OpenLearn is free to everyone!”; you sign up free to enrol and can earn a free digital badge.

items.name: Open Yale Courses
items.descriptionZh: 耶鲁公开课，官方页写明“provides free and open access to a selection of introductory courses”，多数讲义按 CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 授权，不能商用。
items.descriptionEn: Yale's published courses, which “provide free and open access to a selection of introductory courses”; most material is CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, so commercial reuse is out.

items.name: Class Central
items.descriptionZh: 课程聚合检索站，标题为“Find the best courses, wherever they exist”，本身不授课；首页写“Get the most out of Class Central with a free account”。
items.descriptionEn: A course search engine titled “Find the best courses, wherever they exist” that teaches nothing itself and says to “Get the most out of Class Central with a free account”.

items.name: FutureLearn
items.descriptionZh: 英国课程平台，定价页把免费档标作“Limited Access €0”，自述免费账号只有“Limited access to 1400+ short courses”“Restricted access to course content”，内容按周解锁，完整学习与证书需订阅。
items.descriptionEn: A UK platform whose pricing table marks the free tier “Limited Access €0”, giving “Limited access to 1400+ short courses” with content released weekly; full access and certificates need a subscription.

items.name: Saylor Academy
items.descriptionZh: 自学课程库，站点现以 Saylor University 呈现，标语为“Enroll Anytime — 100% Online, Self-Paced, and Tuition Free!”，课程免费但学位项目另算。
items.descriptionEn: A self-paced course library now presented as Saylor University, banner “Enroll Anytime - 100% Online, Self-Paced, and Tuition Free!”, where courses are free but degree study is priced separately.

items.name: NPTEL
items.descriptionZh: 印度政府主导的工程与科学课程库，页面标注“Distributed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike CC BY - NC - SA”，即需署名、不得商用且改作同授权。
items.descriptionEn: India's government-run engineering and science course archive, marked “Distributed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike CC BY - NC - SA”, so reuse must credit, stay non-commercial and share alike.

items.name: 学堂在线
items.descriptionZh: 中文慕课平台，标题自述“Online Courses from Top Universities”；本轮首页看到的是认证班、证书班与限时特惠，免费旁听与付费认证的分界未取证。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese MOOC platform titled “Online Courses from Top Universities”; this round its homepage showed certificate tracks and discounted cohorts, so the free-audit line is unverified.

items.name: 网易公开课
items.descriptionZh: 网易的公开课聚合，首页称“TED演讲全网首播，15000+名校课程免费观看”，同时设有已购课程，并说明部分字幕译自人人影视、TLF 等站点发布的素材。
items.descriptionEn: NetEase's open-course hub, claiming “15000+名校课程免费观看” alongside purchased courses and noting that some subtitles derive from fan-published material.

items.name: ALISON
items.descriptionZh: 爱尔兰的课程站，标题即“Free Online Courses & Online Learning | Alison”，站内以登录注册与联盟推广为主，证书是否收费本轮未取证。
items.descriptionEn: An Irish course site titled “Free Online Courses & Online Learning | Alison”, built around sign-up and affiliate promotion; whether certificates are charged was not captured.

items.name: TED-Ed
items.descriptionZh: TED 的教育频道，标题为“Lessons Worth Sharing | TED-Ed”，页面自述接受捐款以支持其非营利使命。
items.descriptionEn: TED's education channel, titled “Lessons Worth Sharing | TED-Ed”, which asks for donations to support its non-profit mission.

items.name: Language Transfer
items.descriptionZh: 靠捐款运行的语言自学课程，官方页写明“no adverts, no sign-ups and no-one asking for or selling your data. LT runs on donations”。
items.descriptionEn: A donation-run language course whose page promises “no adverts, no sign-ups and no-one asking for or selling your data”.

items.name: Anki
items.descriptionZh: 开源间隔重复卡片工具，官方页写明“The free AnkiWeb synchronization service lets you sync your cards across devices”，牌组要自己做或下载别人的。
items.descriptionEn: Open-source spaced-repetition flashcards; “The free AnkiWeb synchronization service lets you sync your cards across devices”, but you build or import the decks yourself.

items.name: Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy
items.descriptionZh: 哲学百科，标题自述“An encyclopedia of philosophy articles written by professional philosophers”，条目由专业作者撰写并署名，长文可直接在线读。
items.descriptionEn: A philosophy encyclopedia titled “An encyclopedia of philosophy articles written by professional philosophers”, with signed scholarly entries readable in the browser.

items.name: Wikiquote
items.descriptionZh: 维基媒体旗下的语录库，门户页显示“Free quote compendium English 72,000+ articles”，内容遵循自由授权可复用。
items.descriptionEn: Wikimedia's quote compendium, whose portal shows “Free quote compendium English 72,000+ articles” under a free licence.

items.name: Wiktionary
items.descriptionZh: 维基媒体旗下的多语言词典，自述“the free dictionary”，文字按 CC BY-SA 4.0 与 GFDL 双授权，任意语言版本可切换。
items.descriptionEn: Wikimedia's multilingual dictionary, self-described as “the free dictionary”, dual-licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL across language editions.

items.name: Encyclopedia.com
items.descriptionZh: 聚合多家出版方条目的百科检索站，标题为“Free Online Encyclopedia”；本轮只核到站点标题，逐条来源与授权未细查。
items.descriptionEn: An aggregator of entries from various publishers, titled “Free Online Encyclopedia”; only the site framing was checked this round, not each entry's source or licence.

items.name: 汉典
items.descriptionZh: 中文在线字典与词语库，首页自述“收录超过十万个汉字，六十万个词语”，另有拼音等栏目，站点自 2004 年运营。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese character and word dictionary saying it “收录超过十万个汉字，六十万个词语”, with pinyin sections, running since 2004.

items.name: 中国百科网
items.descriptionZh: 中文百科条目站，使用说明写明“本站向非付费用户提供每天免费查询 3个 条目全文的基础服务。若需更多服务，请购买使用权益”，个人与机构均需购买。
items.descriptionEn: A Chinese encyclopedia whose terms give non-paying users “每天免费查询 3个 条目全文” and sell anything beyond that to individuals or institutions.

items.name: Statista
items.descriptionZh: 统计与市场调研门户，页面标出“BASIC ACCOUNT For single users $0 USD Always free”，同时写明“Access all statistics starting from $2,388 USD yearly”，Starter 账号 199 美元一月按年计费。
items.descriptionEn: A statistics and market-research portal: the page lists a “BASIC ACCOUNT For single users $0 USD Always free” tier, while full access is quoted “starting from $2,388 USD yearly” and Starter is “$199 USD per month, billed annually”.

items.name: The European Data Portal
items.descriptionZh: 欧盟官方数据门户，汇集成员国公开数据集，导航含快速检索、地理检索、SPARQL 与 API 查询。
items.descriptionEn: The EU's official portal pooling member-state open data, with quick, geospatial, SPARQL and API search in its navigation.

items.name: National Data Library
items.descriptionZh: 英国公共数据总库，标题自述“The home of UK public data”，按天气气候、土地房产、人口等主题分组。
items.descriptionEn: The UK's public data library, titled “The home of UK public data” and grouped by themes such as weather, land and property, and population.

items.name: Data.gov.au
items.descriptionZh: 澳大利亚公共数据目录，页脚说明除国徽等另有标注外，内容按 CC BY 4.0 授权可再使用。
items.descriptionEn: Australia's public data catalogue, whose footer licenses content under CC BY 4.0 apart from the Coat of Arms and noted exceptions.

items.name: Open Government Canada
items.descriptionZh: 加拿大联邦开放数据与信息入口，页面说明可检索各政府机构发布的开放数据。
items.descriptionEn: Canada's federal open data and information entry point, described on the page as a search across datasets published by government institutions.

items.name: Office for National Statistics
items.descriptionZh: 英国国家统计局，页脚写明“All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated”。
items.descriptionEn: The UK statistics office, whose footer states “All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated”.

items.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics
items.descriptionZh: 澳大利亚官方统计机构，站点以统计、普查与调查参与为一级栏目。
items.descriptionEn: Australia's official statistics agency, with Statistics, Census and survey participation as top-level sections.

items.name: Google Dataset Search
items.descriptionZh: 谷歌的数据集搜索引擎，门户提示可用 site: 等语法限定站点检索公开数据集。
items.descriptionEn: Google's dataset search engine, whose portal suggests site: filters to narrow the hunt for public datasets.

items.name: Insee
items.descriptionZh: 法国国家统计与经济研究所，按经济与主题分类检索法国统计与研究报告，站点提供英文版。
items.descriptionEn: France's national statistics and economic studies institute, browsable by economic theme, with an English version of the site.

items.name: 地理空间数据云
items.descriptionZh: 中国科学院计算机网络信息中心运营的遥感数据平台，首页写明“全球覆盖、永久免费、登录即可查询、下载:LANDSAT、SENTINEL、MODIS、DEM、NOAA、LUCC”。
items.descriptionEn: A remote-sensing platform run by the Chinese Academy of Sciences Network Information Center, promising “全球覆盖、永久免费、登录即可查询、下载” for LANDSAT, SENTINEL, MODIS, DEM, NOAA and LUCC data.

items.name: 国家地球系统科学数据中心
items.nameEn: National Earth System Science Data Center
items.descriptionZh: 地球系统科学数据平台，自述建成涵盖五大圈层与陆地表层、20 个二级学科的数据库群，提供数据直接下载与 SWAT 等在线模型，需注册登录。
items.descriptionEn: An earth system science data centre describing databases across five spheres and 20 sub-disciplines, with direct downloads and online models such as SWAT behind registration.

items.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
items.descriptionZh: 欧盟哥白尼数据空间，官网称该生态延续“the open and free access to Copernicus data”，可匿名使用 Copernicus Browser，注册后解锁 openEO、Sentinel Hub 等处理服务。
items.descriptionEn: The EU Copernicus data space, which the site says continues “the open and free access to Copernicus data”; the browser works anonymously while accounts unlock openEO and Sentinel Hub processing.

items.name: USGS EarthExplorer
items.descriptionZh: 美国地质调查局的影像检索与下载站，页面提示部分数据下载前需同意最终用户协议，批量导出可能要等待处理。
items.descriptionEn: The USGS imagery search and download workbench, which warns that some downloads require accepting an end-user agreement and large exports may queue for processing.

items.name: NASA Earthdata
items.descriptionZh: NASA 地球观测数据门户，汇集各 DAAC 数据中心与 Worldview、FIRMS、Giovanni 等工具，页面同时发布数据停更与迁移公告。
items.descriptionEn: NASA's gateway to Earth observation data, listing the DAAC archives plus tools such as Worldview, FIRMS and Giovanni, alongside data outage and migration notices.

items.name: Met Office Data Services
items.descriptionZh: 英国气象局数据服务页，说明同时提供“Public Sector Information (PSI) data”、需许可复用的数据、“open data sets available with free access”与面向商业的行业数据。
items.descriptionEn: The UK Met Office data services page, which lists PSI data, data re-used under licence, “open data sets available with free access” and industry-specific feeds for business.

items.name: National Weather Service
items.descriptionZh: 美国官方预报站，栏目含本地预报、飓风、河湖水位、火灾天气，以及过去天气与认证气象数据入口。
items.descriptionEn: The US official forecast site, with local forecasts, hurricanes, rivers and lakes, fire weather, plus past weather and certified weather data entries.

items.name: EUMETSAT
items.descriptionZh: 欧洲气象卫星组织，站点提供 Meteosat、Metop、Sentinel 与 Jason-3 系列的实时云图（EUMETView）与数据政策说明。
items.descriptionEn: Europe's meteorological satellite organisation, offering EUMETView real-time imagery from the Meteosat, Metop, Sentinel and Jason-3 series plus its data policy.

items.name: Exploding Topics
items.descriptionZh: 趋势发现平台，定价页把“Comprehensive Trends Database”等能力列在 Pro 产品下，导航另有 Free Tools 与 Pricing 入口。
items.descriptionEn: A trend-discovery platform whose pricing page puts the “Comprehensive Trends Database” and related features behind the Pro product, with Free Tools and Pricing in the navigation.

items.name: 今日热榜
items.descriptionZh: 聚合知乎、微博、微信、百度、哔哩哔哩等平台热榜的第三方站点，页面同时展示电商热销与赞助商广告位。
items.descriptionEn: A third-party aggregator of Chinese hot lists from Zhihu, Weibo, WeChat, Baidu, Bilibili and more, whose page also carries commerce rankings and sponsor slots.

items.name: 新榜
items.descriptionZh: 新媒体内容与账号数据平台，首页导航含榜单与投放变现，并发布内容产业年度报告。
items.descriptionEn: A new-media content and account data platform whose home navigation offers rankings and monetisation, plus annual industry reports.

links.descriptionEn: OpenAI's general chat and creation assistant, with a free plan.

links.description: 把资料交给它作答、总结与生成音频概览，原 NotebookLM。

links.description: 围绕文献做检索、筛选与信息提取，提供免费体验。
links.descriptionEn: Literature search, screening, and data extraction you can start for free.

links.name: Adobe Firefly
links.description: Adobe 的生成式创作入口，免费方案提供每日生成额度。
links.descriptionEn: Adobe's generative creation hub; the free plan gives daily generations.

links.name: Leonardo
links.description: 面向美术与游戏资源的 AI 图像与视频平台，免费用户每天获得重置额度。
links.descriptionEn: AI image and video platform for art and game assets; free users get tokens that reset daily.

links.name: Krea
links.description: 聚合多种图像与视频模型的创作画布，部分模型可免费使用。
links.descriptionEn: A creation canvas bundling many image and video models, several of them free.

links.name: 即梦
links.description: 字节的图像与视频生成平台，每日登录赠送积分。
links.descriptionEn: ByteDance's image and video generator, granting credits for daily sign-in.

links.name: 可灵 AI
links.description: 快手的视频与图片生成平台，官方会员页标注每天 3 次免费。
links.descriptionEn: Kuaishou's video and image generator; the official membership page lists 3 free generations a day.

links.name: Vidu
links.description: 用文字、图片与参考素材生成视频，注册即可获得免费额度。
links.descriptionEn: AI video from text, images, and references; all users receive free credits.

links.name: ElevenLabs
links.description: 文本转语音、配音与音效生成，提供免费方案。
links.descriptionEn: Text to speech, dubbing, and sound effects with a $0 plan.

links.name: TTSMaker
links.description: 免费在线配音，官方说明每周 20000 字符额度，部分音色不限量。
links.descriptionEn: Free online text to speech; the site states 20,000 characters a week, with some voices unlimited.

links.name: 通义听悟
links.description: 阿里的音视频转写与会议记录工具，可免费体验。
links.descriptionEn: Alibaba's transcription and meeting-notes tool, free to try.

links.name: Notta
links.description: 会议录音转写与摘要，免费方案无需信用卡。
links.descriptionEn: Meeting transcription and summaries; the $0 plan needs no credit card.

links.name: Otter
links.description: 自动加入会议做转写与纪要的 AI 笔记助手，可免费开始。
links.descriptionEn: An AI notetaker that joins meetings to transcribe and summarize; free to start.

links.name: MacWhisper
links.description: Mac 上的本地语音转文字应用，基础功能免费。
links.descriptionEn: A Mac app for local transcription; the core version is free.

links.name: Suno
links.description: 文字生成完整歌曲，免费套餐每天发放积分且不含商用版权。
links.descriptionEn: Turns text into full songs; the free plan gives daily credits without commercial rights.

links.name: Mureka
links.description: MiniMax 的 AI 音乐生成平台，可免费试用并下载曲目。
links.descriptionEn: MiniMax's AI music platform, free to try with downloadable tracks.

links.name: GitHub Copilot
links.description: GitHub 的编程助手，个人免费档提供有限用量。
links.descriptionEn: GitHub's coding assistant; the Free plan gives individuals limited usage.

links.name: Cursor
links.description: 面向 AI 结对编程的编辑器，免费档为有限智能体用量。
links.descriptionEn: An AI pair-programming editor with a limited free tier.

links.name: TRAE
links.description: 字节的 AI IDE，免费档仅提供 Auto 模式与有限用量。
links.descriptionEn: ByteDance's AI IDE; the free plan is auto-mode only with limited usage.

links.name: 通义灵码
links.description: 阿里云的 AI 编程助手，个人可免费使用。
links.descriptionEn: Alibaba Cloud's AI coding assistant, free for individuals.

links.name: Google AI Studio
links.description: 获取 Gemini API 密钥与调用额度，设有免费使用层。
links.descriptionEn: Get Gemini API keys and quota; a free usage tier is documented.

links.name: OpenRouter
links.description: 一个接口调用大量模型，免费档含 25 款以上免费模型与每日请求上限。
links.descriptionEn: One endpoint for many models; the free tier lists 25+ free models with a daily request cap.

links.name: Groq
links.description: 以快速推理著称的模型 API，官方文档列出免费方案限额。
links.descriptionEn: A fast-inference model API whose docs publish free-plan limits.

links.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
links.description: 在 Cloudflare 边缘运行模型，每天 1 万 Neurons 免费额度。
links.descriptionEn: Run models on Cloudflare's edge with 10,000 free Neurons a day.

links.name: 硅基流动
links.description: 国内大模型 API 平台，定价页列出多款免费模型。
links.descriptionEn: A China-based model API platform whose pricing page lists free models.

links.name: DeepL
links.description: 以准确度著称的翻译工具，翻译器可直接免费使用。
links.descriptionEn: A translation tool known for accuracy; the translator is free to use.

links.name: Grammarly
links.description: 英文写作建议与语法辅助工具，提供免费方案。
links.descriptionEn: Writing suggestions and grammar assistance, with a free plan.

links.name: 百度网盘
links.description: 国内用户最多的通用网盘，更大空间与下载提速属于会员权益。
links.descriptionEn: China's most widely used drive, where extra space and faster downloads are membership perks.

links.name: 阿里云盘
links.description: 阿里巴巴出品，主打备份与分享，免费容量在客户端领取。
links.descriptionEn: Alibaba's drive built around backup and sharing; the free capacity is claimed in its apps.

links.name: 夸克网盘
links.description: 与夸克浏览器、播放器打通的网盘，支持在线播放与收发大文件。
links.descriptionEn: A drive tied to Quark's browser and player, with online playback and large-file transfers.

links.name: 123云盘
links.description: 官方称免费与付费用户上传下载均不限速，下载无需登录。
links.descriptionEn: States that uploads and downloads are never throttled, for free and paid users alike, and that downloading needs no login.

links.name: 天翼云盘
links.description: 中国电信出品的网盘，主打不限速与家庭共享空间。
links.descriptionEn: China Telecom's drive, pitched on unrestricted speed and a shared family space.

links.name: Google Drive
links.description: Google 账号自带的云存储，与文档等办公套件打通。
links.descriptionEn: Cloud storage included with a Google account, integrated with Docs and the rest of Workspace.

links.name: OneDrive
links.description: 微软个人云盘，随 Windows 与 Office 一起使用最顺手。
links.descriptionEn: Microsoft's consumer drive, most at home alongside Windows and the Office apps.

links.name: Dropbox
links.description: 老牌云同步网盘，免费版容量有限。
links.descriptionEn: Long-established sync drive whose free plan carries limited space.

links.name: MEGA
links.description: 端到端加密网盘，官网称其免费方案在同类中容量最大。
links.descriptionEn: End-to-end encrypted drive whose own page calls the free plan the largest any provider offers.

links.name: iCloud
links.description: 苹果设备的云端存储与同步服务。
links.descriptionEn: Apple's cloud storage and syncing across its devices.

links.name: Proton Drive
links.description: Proton 出品的端到端加密网盘，注册即有免费空间。
links.descriptionEn: End-to-end encrypted drive from Proton, with storage granted at sign-up.

links.name: Filen
links.description: 主打端到端加密的网盘，免费注册无需信用卡。
links.descriptionEn: An encryption-first drive you can register for free without a card.

links.name: Internxt
links.description: 强调加密与隐私的网盘，免费方案空间较小。
links.descriptionEn: A privacy-first drive whose free plan is deliberately small.

links.name: Sync.com
links.description: 以零知识加密为卖点的网盘，注册即可免费使用。
links.descriptionEn: A drive sold on zero-knowledge encryption, free to sign up for and use.

links.name: 坚果云
links.description: 国内老牌同步盘，官方提供 WebDAV 接口，支持 WebDAV 的笔记、扫描与备份应用可直接读写云端文件。
links.descriptionEn: A long-established Chinese sync drive with an official WebDAV endpoint, so note-taking, scanning and backup apps that speak WebDAV can read and write your files directly.

links.name: pCloud
links.description: 提供 WebDAV 等直连接口的网盘，官方帮助页写明这些接口对所有套餐开放，含免费账号。
links.descriptionEn: A drive offering WebDAV and similar direct endpoints, which its help page says are open on every plan, free accounts included.

links.name: Koofr
links.description: 欧洲网盘，官方称一定额度内永久免费；其 WebDAV 需先生成应用专用密码，常被接给文献管理与 NAS。
links.descriptionEn: A European drive that keeps a set allowance free forever; its WebDAV access needs an app-specific password and is commonly wired into reference managers and NAS boxes.

links.name: WeTransfer
links.description: 老牌免注册发文件服务，免费版按周期计量额度。
links.descriptionEn: Long-running service for sending large files without an account; the free plan is capped each month.

links.name: SwissTransfer
links.description: 瑞士 Infomaniak 出品，无需注册即可发送大文件，传输设有保存期限。
links.descriptionEn: From Swiss host Infomaniak; send large files with no sign-up, with an expiry on each transfer.

links.name: 文叔叔
links.description: 国内传文件工具，官方称永不限速并附赠免费网盘空间。
links.descriptionEn: Chinese file-transfer tool that promises unlimited speed and bundled free drive space.

links.name: 奶牛快传
links.description: 面向创作的大文件传输工具，官方称上传下载不限速。
links.descriptionEn: A large-file transfer tool for creators that says uploads and downloads are never throttled.

links.name: LocalSend
links.description: 开源传输工具，文件只在同一网络内直连传输，不经过服务器。
links.descriptionEn: Open-source transfer app that sends files directly over your local network without passing through a server.

links.name: Project Gutenberg
links.description: 公共领域电子书的经典数字图书馆，首页写明“100% Free - No fees, no registration”。
links.descriptionEn: The classic digital library of public-domain e-books, promising “100% Free - No fees, no registration”.

links.name: Standard Ebooks
links.description: 志愿者重排的公共领域电子书，自述“lovingly formatted, open source, free of U.S. copyright restrictions, and free of cost”。
links.descriptionEn: Volunteer-made editions of public-domain books, “lovingly formatted, open source” and free of cost.

links.name: Internet Archive
links.description: 数字图书、影音与网页存档的非营利图书馆。
links.descriptionEn: A non-profit library of digital books, media and web archives.

links.name: Open Library
links.description: 可借阅电子书的开放图书馆计划，首页写明“Millions of books available through Controlled Digital Lending”。
links.descriptionEn: An open lending library whose books are loaned under controlled digital lending.

links.name: Wikisource
links.description: 自由许可与公共领域原始文本图书馆。
links.descriptionEn: A library of free and public-domain source texts.

links.name: 中国哲学书电子化计划
links.description: 先秦至明清中文原典检索库，官方页写明靠机构订阅支撑“supporting free access for everyone”。
links.descriptionEn: A searchable library of pre-modern Chinese texts, funded by institutional subscriptions that keep reading free for everyone.

links.name: arXiv
links.description: 自述“a free distribution service and an open-access archive for more than 3.2 million scholarly articles”。
links.descriptionEn: A free distribution service and open-access archive of more than 3.2 million scholarly papers.

links.name: Google Scholar
links.description: 检索学术文献、引用与作者信息。
links.descriptionEn: Search scholarly literature, citations, and authors.

links.name: PubMed
links.description: 美国国家医学图书馆的文献索引，条目常标“Free PMC article”并链向公共医学全文库。
links.descriptionEn: The US National Library of Medicine's index; records are often tagged “Free PMC article” and link to free full text.

links.name: DOAJ
links.description: 开放获取学术期刊目录，收录期刊在其站内“freely accessible to everyone”，运营靠捐赠。
links.descriptionEn: A directory of open-access journals whose listed content is freely accessible; the service runs on donations.

links.name: 国家哲学社会科学文献中心
links.description: 国家投入建设的哲学社科文献平台，注册后可检索中文期刊全文；官方说明中文期刊提供全文下载，外文期刊与古籍以在线阅读为主。
links.descriptionEn: A state-funded platform for philosophy and social-science literature; registration unlocks Chinese-journal full-text download, while foreign journals and rare books are read online.

links.name: MIT OpenCourseWare
links.description: MIT 公开课程材料。
links.descriptionEn: MIT's published course materials.

links.name: Khan Academy
links.description: 面向大众的免费在线教育平台，使命句为“provide a free, world-class education for anyone, anywhere”。
links.descriptionEn: Free online education for anyone, anywhere; funded by donors and partners.

links.name: Coursera
links.description: 大学与机构课程平台，课程页可“Enroll for free”，完整内容与证书走订阅与试用。
links.descriptionEn: University courses you can enrol in for free, with full work and certificates behind a subscription.

links.name: LibreTexts
links.description: 覆盖多学科的开放教育资源平台。
links.descriptionEn: Open educational resources across many disciplines.

links.name: Wikibooks
links.description: 自由编写的教材、手册与学习资料。
links.descriptionEn: Free textbooks, manuals, and learning materials.

links.name: OpenStax
links.description: 免费开放教材，页面写明“Adopt peer-reviewed texts at no cost”且无广告。
links.descriptionEn: Peer-reviewed open textbooks adopted at no cost, with no ads.

links.name: 国家中小学智慧教育平台
links.description: 教育部主导的中小学资源平台，介绍页写明“平台所有资源均免费使用，任何单位及个人不得用于商业行为”。
links.descriptionEn: The Ministry of Education's school platform, where all resources are free but commercial use is barred.

links.name: 中国大学MOOC
links.description: 网易与高教社出品的中文慕课平台，首页称“免费学习来自名校名师的精品课程”，另设认证学习会员。
links.descriptionEn: Chinese MOOCs from co-operating universities; courses are free to study, with a paid verified-study membership on top.

links.name: 维基百科
links.description: 维基媒体旗下的自由百科，门户页显示英文“7,254,000+ articles”，文字按 CC BY-SA 授权。
links.descriptionEn: The free encyclopedia; its portal lists 7.25 million-plus English articles under CC BY-SA.

links.name: TED
links.description: 免费演讲与思想分享视频。
links.descriptionEn: Free talks and ideas worth spreading.

links.name: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
links.description: 由学者维护的开放哲学百科。
links.descriptionEn: A scholar-maintained open encyclopedia of philosophy.

links.name: wikiHow
links.description: 步骤式生活与技能指南站，标题自述“How-to instructions you can trust.”。
links.descriptionEn: Step-by-step how-to guides, titled “How-to instructions you can trust”.

links.name: Open Culture
links.description: 免费课程、电影、有声书与文化资源目录。
links.descriptionEn: Directory of free courses, films, audiobooks, and culture.

links.name: YouTube
links.description: 全球性视频分享平台，站内同时细分出 Kids、Music、Premium、TV 等产品线。
links.descriptionEn: A global video-sharing platform whose site also splits out Kids, Music, Premium and TV products.

links.name: 哔哩哔哩
links.description: 以用户投稿与弹幕为核心的视频社区，站内自述为“国内知名的视频弹幕网站”，并写明登录后可以免费观看高清视频。
links.descriptionEn: A Chinese video community built on user uploads and bullet comments; it calls itself a well-known danmaku video site and says logged-in users can watch HD videos for free.

links.name: Vimeo
links.description: 面向创作者与专业视频的托管平台，首页写明任何人都能免费发布无限公开视频，定价页从免费档排到企业档。
links.descriptionEn: A hosting platform for creators and professional video; its homepage says anyone can share unlimited public videos for free, and the pricing page runs from a free plan up to enterprise.

links.name: Tubi
links.description: 广告支持的免费影视平台，页面标题即“Watch Free Movies and TV Shows Online”。
links.descriptionEn: Ad-supported free film and TV platform, titled “Watch Free Movies and TV Shows Online”.

links.name: Pluto TV
links.description: 免费直播频道与点播内容，首页写明“All free, no payment required. Ever.”，靠短广告段支撑；访问会按地区跳到对应分站。
links.descriptionEn: Free live channels and on-demand shows; the homepage states “All free, no payment required. Ever.” and it runs on short ad breaks, redirecting visitors to a regional sub-site.

links.name: Plex
links.description: 除自建媒体库外，官方免费电视页写明有“600+ channels”的免费直播频道，另设 Free Movies & Shows 点播入口，页面提示注册免费账号。
links.descriptionEn: Beyond the self-hosted media server, Plex's free-TV page advertises “600+ channels” of free live TV plus a Free Movies & Shows area, and asks you to create a free account.

links.name: ARTE
links.description: 法德公共电视台的点播平台，站名自述“the European culture TV channel, free and on demand”，界面提供七种语言。
links.descriptionEn: The on-demand platform of the Franco-German public channel, self-described as “the European culture TV channel, free and on demand”, with seven interface languages.

links.name: 1905电影网
links.description: 电影频道节目中心（CCTV-6）官方网站，首页有 CCTV6 直播与“免费大片”专区，另设 VIP 影院栏目。
links.descriptionEn: The official site of China's movie channel programme centre (CCTV-6), with a CCTV6 live stream and a “免费大片” free-feature section next to a VIP cinema area.

links.name: Internet Archive Movies
links.description: 互联网档案馆的影视分区，站点自述收录“Free & Borrowable Texts, Movies, Music”，公共领域条目可直接观看，部分影片需登录借阅。
links.descriptionEn: The film section of the Internet Archive, a site that advertises “Free & Borrowable Texts, Movies, Music”; public-domain items stream directly while some titles need a logged-in borrow.

links.name: Spotify
links.description: 音乐与播客平台，付费页写明可以“sign up to Spotify for free”，免费档听歌带广告，无广告与无损音质属 Premium。
links.descriptionEn: Music and podcast platform whose Premium page invites you to “sign up to Spotify for free”; the free tier carries ads, while ad-free and lossless listening belong to Premium.

links.name: Deezer
links.description: 音乐流媒体服务，首页问答自述“Deezer Free offers a completely free music app experience”，离线下载与无损属付费档。
links.descriptionEn: Music streaming whose homepage FAQ states “Deezer Free offers a completely free music app experience”, leaving offline listening and hi-fi sound to paid plans.

links.name: SoundCloud
links.description: 音乐人上传与分享作品的社区，页面标题即“Stream and listen to music online for free with SoundCloud”。
links.descriptionEn: A community where artists upload and share tracks; the page title reads “Stream and listen to music online for free with SoundCloud”.

links.name: Bandcamp
links.description: 独立音乐人直接发售专辑与单曲的平台，首页滚动展示实时购买，并写明乐迷已通过它向艺人支付 18 亿美元以上。
links.descriptionEn: A platform where independent artists sell albums and tracks directly; its homepage runs a live purchase feed and states fans have paid artists over $1.8 billion through Bandcamp.

links.name: Jamendo
links.description: 独立音乐平台，站点标题自述“Free music downloads”；正文为脚本渲染，逐首曲目的授权范围本轮未取到。
links.descriptionEn: An independent music platform titled “Free music downloads”; the page body is script-rendered, so per-track licensing was not captured this round.

links.group: 开放授权与公共领域音频
links.name: Musopen
links.description: 提供公有领域的古典音乐录音、乐谱与教材，自述“we provide recordings, sheet music, and textbooks to the public for free, without copyright restrictions”，另有 55 美元/年的会员与捐赠。
links.descriptionEn: Publishes public-domain classical recordings, sheet music and textbooks — “we provide recordings, sheet music, and textbooks to the public for free, without copyright restrictions” — with a $55/year membership and donations alongside.

links.group: 开放授权与公共领域音频
links.name: Free Music Archive
links.description: 免版税音乐库，首页写明“Royalty free music. Safe to use in all kinds of media like YouTube, Facebook and podcast episodes”，具体授权按曲目标注。
links.descriptionEn: A royalty-free music library stating “Royalty free music. Safe to use in all kinds of media like YouTube, Facebook and podcast episodes”, with licensing marked per track.

links.group: 开放授权与公共领域音频
links.name: Freesound
links.description: 由用户提交的音效协作库，首页写明收录 73 万余个免费音频，自述为“collaborative database of creative-commons licensed sound”，运营方是庞培法布拉大学。
links.descriptionEn: A community sound-effects database listing over 738,000 free sounds and describing itself as a “collaborative database of creative-commons licensed sound”, run by Universitat Pompeu Fabra.

links.name: Apple Podcasts
links.description: 苹果播客的网页版播放器，标题为“Apple Podcasts - Web Player”，无需装客户端即可浏览新节目与榜单。
links.descriptionEn: The web player for Apple Podcasts, titled “Apple Podcasts - Web Player”, listing new shows and charts without needing the desktop app.

links.name: BBC Sounds
links.description: BBC 的节目、播客与电台入口，页面标题自述“BBC Sounds - Music. Radio. Podcasts”。
links.descriptionEn: BBC's entry point for programmes, podcasts and radio, titled “BBC Sounds - Music. Radio. Podcasts”.

links.name: SomaFM
links.description: 美国网络电台，页面标题自述“Commercial-free, Listener-supported Radio”，站内导航设有 support/donate 与 store 入口，靠听众捐款与自家商店维持。
links.descriptionEn: An internet radio station whose page title reads “Commercial-free, Listener-supported Radio”, with support/donate and store links in its navigation — funded by listener donations and its own shop.

links.name: Unsplash
links.description: 高质量摄影图库，照片免费下载，商用非商用都可、无需署名。
links.descriptionEn: A high-quality photo library whose licence page allows free downloads for commercial and non-commercial use without permission.

links.name: Pexels
links.description: 照片与视频素材，免费下载使用、无需署名。
links.descriptionEn: Photos and video clips, free to download and use without attribution.

links.name: Pixabay
links.description: 免费图片、视频、音效与插画资源。
links.descriptionEn: Free images, video, sound effects, and illustrations.

links.name: Mixkit
links.description: 免费的视频、音乐和模板素材。
links.descriptionEn: Free video, music, and template assets.

links.name: Coverr
links.description: 免费高清与 4K 视频素材，站内声明免版权费用。
links.descriptionEn: Free HD and 4K stock video, advertised on site as royalty-free.

links.name: Iconify
links.description: 把多套开源图标集收进一套调用方式，图标各自保留原授权。
links.descriptionEn: Puts many open-source icon sets behind one way of calling icons, while each icon keeps its own licence.

links.name: Font Awesome
links.description: 广泛使用的图标库，官方下载页区分免费版与付费版。
links.descriptionEn: A widely used icon library whose official download page separates the Free and Pro editions.

links.name: SVG Repo
links.description: 大量开放授权的 SVG 图标与矢量图，站内说明可免费下载商用。
links.descriptionEn: A large library of open-licensed SVG icons and vectors the site says are free to download and use commercially.

links.name: Tabler Icons
links.description: 风格统一的开源 SVG 图标集，MIT 授权，另有付费多格式打包。
links.descriptionEn: A consistent open-source SVG icon set under the MIT licence, with a paid multi-format bundle.

links.name: Lucide
links.description: 社区维护的线性图标集，ISC 授权，提供 React、Vue 等组件包。
links.descriptionEn: A community-maintained line-icon set under the ISC licence, shipped as React, Vue and other packages.

links.name: Heroicons
links.description: Tailwind CSS 作者手写的 SVG 图标，MIT 授权。
links.descriptionEn: Hand-crafted SVG icons by the makers of Tailwind CSS, MIT licensed.

links.name: unDraw
links.description: 可自定义颜色的开源插画，站内说明可免费商用、无需署名。
links.descriptionEn: Open-source illustrations you can recolour on the site, described as free for commercial or personal use without attribution.

links.name: Open Peeps
links.description: 手绘人物插画拼搭库，CC0 授权，可自由改动商用。
links.descriptionEn: Hand-drawn characters you mix and match, released under CC0 for any use.

links.name: Humaaans
links.description: 可自由搭配发型与服饰的人物插画，CC0 授权。
links.descriptionEn: Mix-and-match people illustrations under the CC0 public-domain licence.

links.name: ManyPixels
links.description: 免费插画与剪贴图库，站内说明个人与商业项目使用都无需署名。
links.descriptionEn: Free illustrations and clip art the site says can be used in personal or commercial projects without attribution.

links.name: Google Fonts
links.description: 收录开源字体与图标，可按语言、字重筛选并生成网页引用。
links.descriptionEn: A catalogue of open-source fonts and icons you can filter by language and weight and embed as web fonts.

links.name: 阿里巴巴普惠体
links.description: 阿里发布的中文黑体字库，官方站点自述为“永久免费正版商用字体”。
links.descriptionEn: Alibaba's Chinese sans-serif family, described by its own official site as a permanently free font for commercial use.

links.name: Font Squirrel
links.description: 人工筛选的免费字体站，可按授权类型筛选，并提供 Webfont 生成工具。
links.descriptionEn: A hand-picked free font library with licence filters and a webfont generator.

links.name: DaFont
links.description: 字体发现与下载目录，需留意每款许可。
links.descriptionEn: Font discovery directory; check each font's license.

links.name: Figma
links.description: 在线协作设计工具，官方定价页把 Starter 列为免费方案。
links.descriptionEn: A collaborative design tool whose pricing page lists a free Starter plan.

links.name: Photopea
links.description: 浏览器中的图像编辑器，兼容 PSD。
links.descriptionEn: Browser image editor with PSD support.

links.name: Krita
links.description: 免费开源的数字绘画软件。
links.descriptionEn: Free and open-source digital painting software.

links.name: Coolors
links.description: 快速生成和管理配色方案。
links.descriptionEn: Generate and manage color palettes quickly.

links.name: Penpot
links.description: 开源的在线设计与原型平台，可免费注册，也能自建部署。
links.descriptionEn: An open-source design and prototyping platform with free hosted accounts and a self-hosted option.

links.name: Affinity
links.description: 设计、图像编辑与排版合为一个桌面应用，官方页写明个人免费、企业另购。
links.descriptionEn: Design, photo editing and layout in one app; the official page says it is free for individuals, with paid options for enterprises.

links.name: 即时设计
links.description: 国产在线 UI 设计与协作工具，首页提供免费使用与私有化部署咨询。
links.descriptionEn: A Chinese online UI design and collaboration tool whose homepage offers free sign-up and private-deployment enquiries.

links.name: Blender
links.description: 免费开源的 3D 创作套件。
links.descriptionEn: Free and open-source 3D creation suite.

links.name: Poly Haven
links.description: CC0 授权的 HDRI、贴图、模型与音频库，免注册下载。
links.descriptionEn: A CC0 library of HDRIs, textures, models and audio you can download without signing up.

links.name: ambientCG
links.description: CC0 授权的 PBR 材质、HDRI 与 3D 模型，可免费商用、无需署名。
links.descriptionEn: CC0 PBR materials, HDRIs and 3D models, free for commercial use without attribution.

links.name: Sketchfab
links.description: 3D 模型展示与下载平台，可免费加入；付费模型转到 Fab 交易。
links.descriptionEn: A platform to showcase and download 3D models with free sign-up; paid models are handled through its Fab marketplace.

links.name: GitHub
links.description: 代码托管、开源协作与开发者社区。
links.descriptionEn: Code hosting, open-source collaboration and developer community.

links.name: GitLab
links.description: 代码托管与 DevOps 协作平台。
links.descriptionEn: Code hosting and DevOps collaboration platform.

links.name: Bitbucket
links.description: Atlassian 旗下的代码托管与团队协作平台。
links.descriptionEn: Atlassian's Git code hosting and team collaboration platform.

links.name: Azure Repos
links.description: 微软 Azure DevOps 提供的私有代码托管服务，小团队免费。
links.descriptionEn: Microsoft's private code hosting in Azure DevOps, free for small teams.

links.name: Gitee 码云
links.description: 国内主流的开源代码托管与协作平台。
links.descriptionEn: A leading code hosting and collaboration platform in China.

links.name: Codeberg
links.description: 由非营利组织运营的社区代码托管平台。
links.descriptionEn: A community code forge operated by a non-profit organization.

links.name: SourceForge
links.description: 老牌开源项目托管与软件下载平台。
links.descriptionEn: Long-standing hosting and download hub for open-source projects.

links.name: Vercel
links.description: 前端与全栈应用的部署托管，提供免费 Hobby 方案。
links.descriptionEn: Deploy front-end and full-stack apps with a free Hobby plan.

links.name: Netlify
links.description: 静态网站与前端应用的托管与部署平台。
links.descriptionEn: Hosting and deployment for static sites and web apps.

links.name: Cloudflare
links.description: 集 CDN、DNS、Pages 与 Workers 于一体的边缘平台，含免费层。
links.descriptionEn: Edge platform with CDN, DNS, Pages, and Workers; free tier.

links.name: GitHub Pages
links.description: 在 GitHub 上免费托管静态网站。
links.descriptionEn: Host static sites for free on GitHub.

links.name: Firebase
links.description: Google 的应用开发与托管平台，含免费 Spark 方案。
links.descriptionEn: Google's app platform with a free Spark plan.

links.name: Render
links.description: 托管 Web 服务、数据库与静态站，提供免费方案。
links.descriptionEn: Host web services, databases, and static sites with a free plan.

links.name: Koyeb
links.description: 在边缘部署容器与无服务应用，提供免费方案。
links.descriptionEn: Deploy containers and serverless apps at the edge, free tier.

links.name: Deno Deploy
links.description: 为 JS 与 TypeScript 提供免费的边缘无服务托管。
links.descriptionEn: Free edge serverless hosting for JS and TypeScript.

links.name: PythonAnywhere
links.description: 在线托管与运行 Python Web 应用，提供免费账户。
links.descriptionEn: Host and run Python web apps online with a free account.

links.name: Amazon AWS
links.description: 综合云服务，至今仍有一批长期免费服务；2025 年 7 月起新账号的免费方式改为 $200 赠金加 6 个月免费计划，到期就要付费。
links.descriptionEn: Broad cloud platform that still carries a set of always-free services; for new accounts since July 2025 the free offer is $200 in credits plus a 6-month free plan, after which you pay.

links.name: Google Cloud
links.description: 云计算平台，含永久免费实例与新账户赠金。
links.descriptionEn: Cloud platform with an always-free VM and credits for new accounts.

links.name: Microsoft Azure
links.description: 云计算服务，新账户赠金与部分永久免费产品。
links.descriptionEn: Cloud services with credits and some always-free products.

links.name: Oracle Cloud
links.description: 以 Always Free 永久免费虚拟机著称的云平台，注册需绑卡验证身份。
links.descriptionEn: Cloud known for its Always Free virtual machines; sign-up requires a card for identity verification.

links.name: Northwest Registered Agent
links.description: 每个账号首个真域名（价值上限 25 美元，含 .com）免注册费且终身免续费，海外也可注册；转出即失去免费续费。
links.descriptionEn: The first real domain per account (up to a $25 value, .com included) is free to register and renews free for the life of the account, and signup works outside the US; transferring out ends the free renewals.

links.name: EU.org
links.description: 1996 年至今提供免费域名，在网页表单提交后由人工处理，官方说要等几天；拿到的是 .org 下的独立 zone，与欧盟无关，也不是真顶级域名。
links.descriptionEn: Free names since 1996: you file a web form that staff then handle, which the registry says takes a few days; you get a separate zone under .org, unrelated to the European Union and not a top-level domain.

links.name: kdns.fr
links.description: 法国非营利协会 KataBump 的免费 *.kdns.fr 二级域名，控制台即时注册，条款未设续费或到期要求；可领数量只写了“每人有合理上限”，没给具体数字。
links.descriptionEn: Free *.kdns.fr subdomains from the French non-profit association KataBump, registered instantly in its console with no renewal or expiry in its terms; the per-account allowance is only described as a reasonable limit, with no number given.

links.name: is-a.dev
links.description: 开发者经 GitHub 申请免费的 *.is-a.dev 子域名，适合个人站点与项目。
links.descriptionEn: Developers claim a free *.is-a.dev subdomain through a GitHub pull request for personal sites and projects.

links.name: PP.UA
links.description: 2008 年起面向个人提供免费域名，须经 NIC.UA 注册并用手机短信验证，未验证的约 5 天后删除。
links.descriptionEn: Free personal domains since 2008, registered through NIC.UA with an SMS code; unverified requests are deleted after about five days.

links.name: FreeDNS
links.description: 老牌免费 DNS 与动态 DNS 托管，可在众多共享域名下领取免费子域名。
links.descriptionEn: The long-running free DNS and dynamic DNS host, where you can claim subdomains across many shared domains.

links.name: DNSExit
links.description: 美国 Netdorm（DNSExit）旗下免费注册，发 work.gd、jo3.org、publicvm.com 等二级域名，可自设 Nameserver，也支持动态 DNS。
links.descriptionEn: Free second-level domains from Netdorm, the company behind DNSExit, under work.gd, jo3.org and publicvm.com, with custom nameservers and dynamic DNS support.

links.name: DuckDNS
links.description: 免费的动态 DNS，可绑定 *.duckdns.org 子域名，适合自建与家庭服务。
links.descriptionEn: Free dynamic DNS for *.duckdns.org subdomains, handy for self-hosting and home servers.

links.name: f5.si
links.description: 日本自 2013 年运营至今，用户名即成 *.f5.si，不需要邮箱，官方明写不过期、不续期也不会被删；自设 Nameserver 需要日本手机号。
links.descriptionEn: Japanese service running since 2013 where your username becomes *.f5.si with no email required and no expiry; delegating nameservers needs a Japanese phone number.

links.name: Supabase
links.description: 开源后端平台，免费方案一个项目里给 Postgres 数据库、文件存储和用户认证；项目一周不用会被暂停，最多两个在用项目。
links.descriptionEn: Open-source backend platform whose free plan bundles a Postgres database, file storage and user authentication per project; projects pause after a week of inactivity and only two may stay active.

links.name: Neon
links.description: Serverless Postgres，免费方案按项目给计算小时与存储，闲置即缩到零，官网写明注册不需信用卡。
links.descriptionEn: Serverless Postgres: the free plan grants each project its own compute hours and storage, scales to zero when idle, and its pricing page states no credit card is required.

links.name: MongoDB Atlas
links.description: MongoDB 官方云数据库，M0 档标注 Free forever，容量与吞吐较小，适合学习和小项目。
links.descriptionEn: MongoDB's official cloud database, where the M0 tier is labelled free forever with storage and throughput sized for learning and small projects.

links.name: Turso
links.description: 托管的 LibSQL（SQLite 分支）数据库，免费方案给上百个数据库与每月读写字数额度，官网写明开始使用不需信用卡。
links.descriptionEn: Managed LibSQL, a SQLite fork, whose free plan covers a hundred-plus databases with monthly row-read and row-write allowances and, per its pricing page, needs no card to start.

links.name: Cloudflare D1
links.description: 跟着 Workers 免费方案使用的边缘 SQLite 数据库，按每天的读写行数限额，读取不计计算费用。
links.descriptionEn: An edge SQLite database used with the Workers free plan, metered by rows read and written per day, with no charge for compute on reads.

links.name: Upstash for Redis
links.description: 无服务的 Redis 与 Kafka，免费层按数据量、命令数和带宽设上限，官方 FAQ 还给了不注册即可领一个免费 Redis 库的接口。
links.descriptionEn: Serverless Redis and Kafka whose free tier caps data size, monthly commands and bandwidth; its FAQ also documents an endpoint that hands out a free Redis database with no signup at all.

links.name: Cloudflare R2
links.description: S3 兼容对象存储，每月有免费存储与请求额度，定价页明写任何存储类型的出网流量都不收费；免费额度只适用标准存储。
links.descriptionEn: S3-compatible object storage with monthly free storage and operation allowances, and a pricing page stating there are no egress charges for any storage class; the free tier applies to Standard storage only.

links.name: Backblaze B2
links.description: S3 兼容对象存储，定价页写明前 10 GB 存储一直免费、出网在月均存储量 3 倍内免费、A/B/C 类请求不收费，建账号不需信用卡。
links.descriptionEn: S3-compatible object storage whose pricing page says the first 10GB is always free, egress is free up to 3x your average monthly storage, Class A, B and C API calls cost nothing, and the signup form requires no card.

links.name: Tigris
links.description: 面向应用的 S3 兼容对象存储，免费额度每月 5 GB 标准存储与读写请求、出网零费用，页面写明开始使用不需绑卡。
links.descriptionEn: Application-focused S3-compatible object storage: each month 5GB of standard storage plus request allowances are free with zero egress fees, and the pricing page states there is no card to start.

links.name: Upstash Blob
links.description: 全球 CDN 分发的 S3 兼容对象存储，官方把免费额度说成硬上限：超出后存储桶停止响应直到 30 天窗口滚动，免费方案永不计费。
links.descriptionEn: S3-compatible object storage replicated to a global CDN. Its pricing page calls the free allowances hard caps: past them the bucket stops serving until the 30-day window rolls over, and the free plan is never charged.

links.name: Oracle Cloud Object Storage
links.description: OCI 的 Always Free 给 20 GB 对象与归档存储、每月 10 TB 出网和 5 万次接口调用；注册需绑卡验证，且免费试用结束时超额的对象会被删除。
links.descriptionEn: Oracle Cloud's Always Free tier includes 20GB of combined object and archive storage, 10TB of monthly outbound transfer and 50,000 API requests; signup needs a card for verification, and objects above the 20GB limit are deleted when a Free Trial ends.

links.name: Clerk
links.description: 给产品直接装上登录与用户管理的组件服务，Hobby 免费方案每个应用 5 万月留存用户、不需信用卡，自定义域名也在免费范围内。
links.descriptionEn: Drop-in sign-in and user-management components: the free Hobby plan covers 50,000 monthly retained users per app with no card required and includes a custom domain.

links.name: Auth0
links.description: Okta 旗下的身份管理平台，免费方案到 2.5 万月活跃用户并含一个自定义域名，但页脚注明启用自定义域名需信用卡验证。
links.descriptionEn: Okta's identity platform: the free plan reaches 25,000 monthly active users and includes one custom domain, though its own footnote says enabling a custom domain needs credit-card verification.

links.name: Firebase Authentication
links.description: Google 的托管登录服务，定价页写明月活跃用户在 5 万以内免费，超出后按 Google Cloud 价格计费；SAML/OIDC 企业登录只免 50 个用户。
links.descriptionEn: Google's managed sign-in service, listed on its pricing page as free up to 50K monthly active users and billed at Google Cloud rates beyond that; SAML/OIDC enterprise sign-ins are only free up to 50 users.

links.name: Kinde
links.description: 面向 B2B 与 B2C 的身份平台，免费方案 10,500 月活跃用户、不需信用卡，多因素验证与自定义域名都含在免费里，另设开发和生产两个环境。
links.descriptionEn: An identity platform for B2B and B2C whose free plan gives 10,500 monthly active users with no card, includes MFA and your own custom domain, and ships with development and production environments.

links.name: Stytch
links.description: 无密码登录与身份 API，按量付费方案常驻 1 万月活跃用户、5 个 SSO/SCIM 连接与无限组织的免费额度；FAQ 明说没有硬上限，超出只按量计费。
links.descriptionEn: Passwordless and identity APIs whose pay-as-you-go tier is always free for 10,000 monthly active users, 5 SSO or SCIM connections and unlimited organizations; its FAQ states there are no hard caps, only usage billing past them.

links.name: Amazon Cognito
links.description: AWS 的用户目录与登录服务，Lite 与 Essentials 定价档每个账号每月 1 万月活跃用户免费，且这份免费额度不随 12 个月新账号期到期；Plus 档没有免费额度。
links.descriptionEn: AWS's user directory and sign-in service: Lite and Essentials pools keep 10,000 free monthly active users per account, and the pricing page says that tier does not expire with the 12-month AWS Free Term. Plus pools have no free tier.

links.name: Stirling PDF

links.name: iLovePDF

links.name: Squoosh

links.name: iLoveIMG

links.name: Remove.bg

links.descriptionEn: Remove image backgrounds with free credits.

links.name: JSON Crack

links.descriptionEn: The site states a subset of real-time IFS and AIFS forecast data is “made available to the public free of charge” under CC-BY-4.0, commercially usable with attribution.

links.name: Copernicus Climate Data Store
links.description: 欧盟哥白尼气候数据仓，首页写着可查“the Earth's past, present and future climate”，并提供 API 取数。
links.descriptionEn: The EU Copernicus climate archive, whose landing page offers the Earth's “past, present and future climate” plus API access.

links.name: NOAA NCEI
links.description: 美国国家环境信息中心的检索入口，页面说明可“Find and download historical weather, climate, and other environmental data”。
links.descriptionEn: The search portal of NOAA's National Centers for Environmental Information, described on the page as a way to “Find and download historical weather, climate, and other environmental data”.

links.name: 中国气象数据网
links.description: 中国气象局国家气象科学数据中心，资料按地面、高空、卫星、雷达与数值预报等类目检索，页面顶部提供登录与注册。
links.descriptionEn: The CMA's national meteorological science data centre, cataloguing surface, upper-air, satellite, radar and numerical forecast datasets behind a sign-in and registration header.

links.name: Google Trends
links.description: 观察搜索兴趣与趋势变化。
links.descriptionEn: Explore changes in search interest and trends.

links.name: Google News
links.description: 聚合来自不同来源的新闻报道。
links.descriptionEn: News coverage aggregated from many sources.

links.name: The GDELT Project
links.description: 把全球广播与网络新闻解析成人物、地点、事件等结构化数据，官网自述“creating a free open platform for computing on the entire world”。
links.descriptionEn: Parses worldwide broadcast and web news into people, places and events, self-described as “creating a free open platform for computing on the entire world”.

links.name: 百度指数
links.description: 百度旗下的指数站点，页面导航只有“首页 最新动态 行业排行”等榜单入口，并提示登录或注册后才能使用。
links.descriptionEn: A Baidu-run index site whose navigation offers latest updates and industry rankings, with login or sign-up prompted at the top.

links.name: Wikimedia Pageviews
links.description: 维基媒体官方的阅读量分析工具，同一页面还提供 Langviews、Topviews、Siteviews 等榜单。
links.descriptionEn: Wikimedia's official view-count analyser, with Langviews, Topviews and Siteviews on the same tool set.
